secret_in_output.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that values that look like passwords or keys were hidden in a result column; {name} is the column, {cell} the cell.

incomplete_output.value: Результат ячейки {cell} неполный (выборка, обрезка или досрочная остановка).
incomplete_output.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Warnings: warning that a cell's exported result is sampled, truncated or stopped early; {cell} is the cell.

too_large.value: Размер файла — {count} байт, это больше предела {limit} байт для блокнотов.
too_large.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook file is over the size limit; {count} is the file size and {limit} the limit, in bytes.

too_deep.value: В файле данные вложены глубже {limit} уровней, поэтому он не открыт.
too_deep.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook file nests data too deeply; {limit} is the maximum depth.

string_too_long.value: Файл содержит значение длиннее {limit} байт, поэтому он не открыт.
string_too_long.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook file contains one oversized value; {limit} is the maximum length in bytes.

not_json.value: Этот файл не является читаемым блокнотом.
not_json.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when the file is not a readable notebook at all.

too_many_cells.value: В блокноте {count} ячеек, это больше предела {limit}.
too_many_cells.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook has more cells than allowed; {count} is the number of cells, {limit} the limit.

too_many_parameters.value: В блокноте {count} параметров, это больше предела {limit}.
too_many_parameters.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook has more parameters than allowed; {count} is the number of parameters, {limit} the limit.

too_many_connections.value: В блокноте {count} подключений, это больше предела {limit}.
too_many_connections.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a notebook declares more connections than allowed; {count} is the number of connections, {limit} the limit.

embedded_credential.value: Одно из подключений в этом блокноте содержит пароль или строку подключения. Блокноты должны ссылаться на подключения только по имени, поэтому он не открыт.
embedded_credential.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when a connection inside a notebook file contains a password or connection string.

unsafe_path.value: Вложение указывает за пределы папки блокнота, поэтому он не открыт.
unsafe_path.location: Notebook → Open file: error shown when an attachment in a notebook file points outside the notebook's folder.

remote_resource.value: Текстовые ячейки ссылаются на изображения или страницы в интернете. Изображения из сети никогда не загружаются, а ссылки открываются только по щелчку.
remote_resource.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when text cells link to images or pages on the internet; web images are never loaded and links open only on click.

active_content.value: Текстовые ячейки содержат скрипты или встроенные страницы. Они показываются как обычный текст и никогда не выполняются.
active_content.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when text cells contain scripts or embedded pages, which are never run.

auto_run_requested.value: Блокнот запрашивает автоматический запуск ячеек. Ничего не будет выполнено, пока вы ему не доверите.
auto_run_requested.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when the notebook file asks to run cells automatically, which is ignored until trusted.

embedded_outputs.value: Блокнот содержит сохранённые результаты другого запуска. Они показываются как снимок, а не как актуальные данные.
embedded_outputs.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when the notebook file contains saved results from another run, shown as a snapshot.

secret_in_content.value: Блокнот содержит то, что похоже на пароль или ключ.
secret_in_content.location: Notebook → Trust banner → File notes: note shown when the notebook file contains something that looks like a password or key.

key_unavailable.value: Сохранённые результаты блокнотов нельзя зашифровать на этом компьютере, поэтому они хранятся только до закрытия блокнота.
key_unavailable.location: Notebook → Saved results: notice shown when no system keychain is available to encrypt saved notebook results.

io.value: Не удалось прочитать или сохранить результаты блокнота: {detail}
io.location: Notebook → Saved results: error shown when saved notebook results cannot be read or written; {detail} is the system error.

too_large.value: Размер этого результата — {bytes} байт, это больше предела {limit} байт для сохранённых результатов, поэтому он не сохраняется.
too_large.location: Notebook → Saved results: notice shown when a result is too large to be saved; {bytes} is its size and {limit} the limit, in bytes.

unavailable.value: Локальные данные блокнота недоступны в браузере. Откройте блокнот в настольном приложении, чтобы работать с ними.
unavailable.location: Browser → Notebook → Local data cell: notice shown in place of a local data cell because the browser build has no local analysis database.

invalid_notebook_id.value: Идентификатор блокнота «{id}» нельзя использовать для локальных данных.
invalid_notebook_id.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the notebook's id cannot name its local data folder; {id} is the id.

invalid_relation_name.value: «{name}» нельзя использовать как имя локальной таблицы. Используйте до 63 латинских букв, цифр и подчёркиваний, начиная с буквы или подчёркивания, и не начинайте имя с _sqlly.
invalid_relation_name.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Materialize locally: error shown when the chosen local table name is not a plain identifier; {name} is the rejected name.

relation_exists.value: Локальная таблица с именем «{name}» уже существует.
relation_exists.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Materialize locally: error shown when a local table with the chosen name already exists; {name} is the name.

relation_not_found.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when a local table (or a table inside an imported SQLite file) does not exist; {name} is the name.

path_not_found.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import file: error shown when the chosen file no longer exists.

path_not_a_file.value: Путь не указывает на обычный файл. Выберите файл, а не папку или устройство.
path_not_a_file.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import or export file: error shown when the chosen path is a folder or device rather than a file.

path_symlink.value: Путь является символической ссылкой. Выберите файл, на который она указывает.
path_symlink.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import or export file: error shown when the chosen path is a symbolic link, which is refused for safety.

path_changed.value: Файл изменился во время чтения. Повторите попытку.
path_changed.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import file: error shown when the file was replaced or changed between checking and reading it.

destination_exists.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Export local data: error shown when the export destination file exists and overwriting was not chosen.

destination_folder_missing.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Export local data: error shown when the folder of the export destination does not exist.

file_too_large.value: Размер файла {size} байт превышает лимит импорта {limit} байт.
file_too_large.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import file: error shown when the file exceeds the import size limit; {size} and {limit} are byte counts.

export_too_large.value: Размер экспорта {size} байт превышает лимит экспорта {limit} байт.
export_too_large.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Export local data: error shown when the exported file exceeds the export size limit; {size} and {limit} are byte counts.

disk_quota.value: Локальные данные этого блокнота занимают {used} байт и достигли лимита {limit} байт. Удалите или очистите локальные таблицы, чтобы освободить место.
disk_quota.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the notebook's local data has reached its disk limit; {used} and {limit} are byte counts.

not_read_only.value: Локальный SQL может только читать данные. Используйте запросы вроде SELECT, WITH, SUMMARIZE или DESCRIBE.
not_read_only.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local SQL cell: error shown when a local query contains a statement that would change data or settings.

file_exchange_unavailable.value: Импорт и экспорт файлов для локальных данных отключены в этом движке.
file_exchange_unavailable.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import or export file: error shown when this engine forbids local data from touching files.

encryption_key.value: Локальные данные этого блокнота зашифрованы, а ключ отсутствует или неверен.
encryption_key.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the notebook's encrypted local data cannot be opened with the stored key.

unprotected_instance.value: Локальная база данных этого блокнота открыта в другом месте без защиты блокнота. Закройте её там и повторите попытку.
unprotected_instance.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the local database file is already open in another window without notebook protections.

malformed.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Import file: error shown when the file cannot be parsed; {format} is the file format name and {detail} the parser's message.

canceled.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: status shown when a materialize, import, export or local query was canceled.

source_failed.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Materialize locally: error shown when the source query stopped sending rows; {detail} is the source's error.

engine.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: generic error from the local analysis database; {detail} is the database's message.

io.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when a local data file cannot be read or written; {detail} is the system message.

workspace_open.value: Локальные данные этого блокнота всё ещё открыты. Закройте блокнот и повторите попытку.
workspace_open.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the notebook's local data is removed or reset while the notebook still has it open.

worker_stopped.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local data: error shown when the background work that reads or writes local data stops unexpectedly; {detail} is the system message.

row_limit.value: Частично: остановлено на лимите {limit} строк для локальных таблиц.
row_limit.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local table badge: note that a materialized or imported table stopped at the row limit; {limit} is the row count.

byte_limit.value: Частично: остановлено на лимите {limit} байт для локальных таблиц.
byte_limit.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local table badge: note that a materialized or imported table stopped at the size limit; {limit} is a byte count.

disk_quota.value: Частично: остановлено, когда локальные данные блокнота достигли лимита диска.
disk_quota.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local table badge: note that a materialized table stopped because the notebook's local data filled its disk limit.

source_incomplete.value: Частично: исходный результат уже был неполным ({detail}).
source_incomplete.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Local table badge: note that the source result was already capped or sampled; {detail} describes how.

awaiting_approval.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged when a cell's statements are waiting in the change review dialog before they run.

completed.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged when a cell's query finished successfully.

empty.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: empty state shown before any cell has run.

failed.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged when a cell's query failed.

queue.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: run queue line listing the cells waiting to run, in order; {cells} is the list of cell names joined by arrows.

queue_empty.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: run queue line shown when no cells are waiting to run.

started.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged when a cell's query is sent to the database.

stopped.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel and status bar: message shown after the user pressed Stop and the run queue was cleared.

title.location: SQL notebook → bottom panel: label on the collapsed strip and title of the panel that lists the run queue, timings and messages.

trusted.value: Блокнот помечен как доверенный; ячейки можно выполнять
trusted.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged after the user trusted a notebook that came from another computer.

writes_allowed.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged after the user confirmed that a cell may run statements that change data.

reused.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged when a run keeps a cell's result because it is still current.

elapsed.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel → entry: how long that run of the cell took, in milliseconds.

add_kind.location: SQL notebook → bottom of the cell list: button that adds a new cell of the named kind at the end; {kind} is the cell kind label such as SQL or Markdown.

collapse.location: SQL notebook → cell header: tooltip and accessible name of the button that hides the cell body.

collapsed_lines.location: SQL notebook → collapsed SQL cell: line shown in place of the hidden SQL, with the number of hidden lines.

delete.location: SQL notebook → cell header: tooltip and accessible name of the button that deletes the cell (it can be undone).

deleted_toast.location: SQL notebook → Delete toast: message at the bottom of the cell list after a cell was deleted; {cell_name} is the deleted cell's name, or its id when it has none.

dismiss_toast.location: SQL notebook → delete toast: tooltip and accessible name of the close button that hides the toast.

elapsed.location: SQL notebook → cell header: how long the cell's last run took, in milliseconds.

expand.location: SQL notebook → cell header: tooltip and accessible name of the button that shows a collapsed cell body again.

kind_markdown.location: SQL notebook → cell header and inspector: label for a Markdown (text) cell.

kind_sql.location: SQL notebook → cell header and inspector: label for a SQL query cell.

kind_unsupported.location: SQL notebook → cell header and inspector: label for a cell whose type this version of SQLLY does not know.

markdown_done.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell being edited: button that stops editing and shows the rendered text.

markdown_done_accessibility.location: SQL notebook → Markdown cell being edited: accessible name of the Done button that shows the rendered text again.

markdown_placeholder.value: *Дважды щёлкните, чтобы написать заметки в Markdown*
markdown_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → empty Markdown cell: placeholder text (itself Markdown) explaining how to start editing.

move_down.location: SQL notebook → cell header: tooltip and accessible name of the button that moves the cell one place down.

move_up.location: SQL notebook → cell header: tooltip and accessible name of the button that moves the cell one place up.

run_accessibility.location: SQL notebook → cell header: tooltip and accessible name of the play button that runs the cell; {cell_name} is the cell's name or id.

sql_placeholder.value: Щёлкните, чтобы написать SQL. Чтобы прочитать результат другой ячейки, укажите её имя в двойных фигурных скобках.
sql_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → empty SQL cell: placeholder text explaining how to start and how to reference another cell.

undo_delete.location: SQL notebook → delete toast: button that puts the deleted cell back where it was.

unsupported_notice.value: Для этой ячейки {kind} нужна более новая версия SQLLY. Она показана только для чтения и сохраняется без изменений.
unsupported_notice.location: SQL notebook → Unsupported cell: body text of a cell whose type is unknown to this version; {kind} is the cell type name stored in the file.

collapsed_lines_one.location: SQL notebook → collapsed SQL cell: line shown in place of the hidden SQL, with the number of hidden lines. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

detected.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged when another program changed the open notebook's file.

indicator.location: SQL notebook → top bar: warning shown when the notebook file was changed by another program since it was opened or saved.

keep_mine.location: SQL notebook → top bar conflict warning: button that keeps the open version so the next save overwrites the file.

reload.location: SQL notebook → top bar conflict warning: button that replaces the open notebook with the version on disk.

cell_tooltip.value: Подключение, на котором выполняется эта ячейка
cell_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → cell header: tooltip of the button that picks the cell's connection.

inherited.location: SQL notebook → cell header: connection button label when the cell uses the notebook's connection; {connection_name} is that connection's name.

menu_item.location: SQL notebook → connection picker menu: one saved connection with its environment, for example Sales DB — Production.

missing_badge.location: SQL notebook → cell header: badge shown when the cell's saved connection does not exist on this computer.

missing_profile.value: Подключения этой ячейки нет на этом компьютере. Сначала выберите для неё локальное подключение.
missing_profile.location: SQL notebook → status bar: error shown when a cell runs on a saved connection that does not exist locally.

none.location: SQL notebook → top bar, cell header and inspector: connection label when neither the cell, the notebook nor the tab has a connection.

use_notebook.location: SQL notebook → cell header → connection picker menu: first item, which makes the cell follow the notebook's connection.

use_tab.location: SQL notebook → top bar connection picker menu: first item, which makes the notebook follow the tab's active connection.

dev.location: SQL notebook → environment badge next to a connection: development environment.

local.location: SQL notebook → environment badge next to a connection: local environment.

production.location: SQL notebook → environment badge next to a connection: production environment.

staging.location: SQL notebook → environment badge next to a connection: staging environment.

test.location: SQL notebook → environment badge next to a connection: test environment.

unset.location: SQL notebook → Environment badge: shown next to a connection that has no environment set.

connection_section.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: section heading for the active cell's connection.

database_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the database the active cell's connection uses.

dependencies_section.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: section heading for the cells the active cell reads from and the cells that read from it.

fingerprint_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the short code that identifies exactly what the cell would run (SQL, parameters, connection).

id_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the active cell's stable id.

kind_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the active cell's type (SQL, Markdown).

last_run_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of when the active cell last finished running.

last_run_value.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: last run value with the time it finished and how long it took.

max_rows_default.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: value shown for the row limit while the cell uses the results grid's default.

max_rows_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the cell's row limit.

name_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the field that names the active cell so other cells can reference it.

name_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: placeholder of the cell name field.

never_run.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: last run value for a cell that has never run.

no_cell.value: Выберите ячейку, чтобы увидеть сведения о ней.
no_cell.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: empty state shown when no cell is selected.

policy_section.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: section heading for the active cell's read-only mode, timeout and row limit.

read_only_accessibility.value: Выполнять эту ячейку только для чтения
read_only_accessibility.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: accessible name of the read-only checkbox.

read_only_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: checkbox that runs the cell in the database's read-only mode; unchecking asks for confirmation.

reads_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label above the cells the active cell references.

run_section.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: section heading for the active cell's state and last run.

state_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the active cell's run state (idle, running, fresh, stale…).

timeout_default.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: value shown for the timeout while the cell uses its connection's timeout.

timeout_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label of the cell's query timeout.

title.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: title of the panel and label on its collapsed strip.

used_by_label.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: label above the cells that reference the active cell.

max_rows_value.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: the most rows the cell keeps from its result.

timeout_value.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: the cell's statement timeout in seconds.

connection_tooltip.value: Подключение, на котором выполняется эта ячейка
connection_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → right inspector → Connection section: tooltip of the button that picks the selected cell's connection.

use_notebook_connection.location: SQL notebook → right inspector → connection picker menu: first item, which makes the selected cell follow the notebook's connection.

max_rows_value_one.location: SQL notebook → right inspector: the most rows the cell keeps from its result. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

convert_to_script.location: Application menu → Query → notebook section: opens the active notebook's SQL as one script in a new query tab.

new_notebook.location: Application menu → File: creates a new, empty SQL notebook tab.

open_as_notebook.location: Application menu → Query → notebook section: opens the active query tab's SQL as a new notebook.

open_notebook.location: Application menu → File: opens a notebook file (.sqlnb.json or Jupyter .ipynb) from disk.

run_all.location: Application menu → Query → notebook section: runs every SQL cell of the active notebook in order.

run_cell.location: Application menu → Query → notebook section: runs the selected cell of the active notebook.

save_notebook.location: Application menu → File: saves the active notebook to its file.

stop.location: Application menu → Query → notebook section: stops the active notebook's run and cancels the running cell.

command_mode.location: Command Palette → Query commands: leaves the cell editor so single keys select, insert, delete and convert cells.

convert_to_markdown.location: Command Palette → Query commands: turns the selected notebook cell into a Markdown cell.

convert_to_sql.location: Command Palette → Query commands: turns the selected notebook cell into a SQL cell.

convert_to_sql_script.location: Command Palette → Query commands: opens the active notebook's SQL as one script in a new query tab.

delete_cell.location: Command Palette → Query commands: deletes the selected notebook cell (it can be undone).

edit_cell.location: Command Palette → Query commands: puts the cursor in the selected notebook cell.

insert_cell_above.location: Command Palette → Query commands: adds a SQL cell above the selected notebook cell.

insert_cell_below.location: Command Palette → Query commands: adds a SQL cell below the selected notebook cell.

open_as_notebook.location: Command Palette → Query commands: opens the active query tab's SQL as a new notebook with one SQL cell.

open_as_notebook_split.value: Открыть запрос как блокнот (одна ячейка на инструкцию)
open_as_notebook_split.location: Command Palette → Query commands: opens the active query tab as a notebook with one SQL cell per statement.

run_cell_and_advance.value: Блокнот: выполнить ячейку и выбрать следующую
run_cell_and_advance.location: Command Palette → Query commands: runs the selected notebook cell and moves to the next one.

run_cell_and_insert_below.value: Блокнот: выполнить ячейку и вставить ниже
run_cell_and_insert_below.location: Command Palette → Query commands: runs the selected notebook cell and adds a new SQL cell under it.

select_next_cell.location: Command Palette → Query commands: selects the notebook cell below the selected one.

select_previous_cell.location: Command Palette → Query commands: selects the notebook cell above the selected one.

allow_writes.location: Command Palette → Query commands: opens the confirmation that lets the selected notebook cell run statements that change data.

trust.location: Command Palette → Query commands: trusts the active notebook so its cells can run, like the Trust notebook button in its banner.

stop.location: Command Palette → Query commands: stops the active notebook's run.

already_notebook.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Open as Notebook is used on a tab that is already a notebook.

convert_menu.location: Workbench → Query tab context menu (notebook tab): item that opens the notebook's SQL as one script in a new query tab.

converted.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation after a notebook was converted to a SQL script in a new tab.

open_menu.location: Workbench → Query tab context menu: item that opens the tab's SQL as a new notebook with one SQL cell.

open_split_menu.value: Открыть как блокнот, одна ячейка на инструкцию
open_split_menu.location: Workbench → Query tab context menu: item that opens the tab's SQL as a new notebook, splitting it into one cell per statement.

opened.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation after a query tab was opened as a notebook; {count} is the number of SQL cells created.

opened_one.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation after a query tab was opened as a notebook; {count} is the number of SQL cells created. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

lineage_detail.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Lineage: second line under a cell listing the cells it reads from and the cells that read from it.

lineage_empty.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Lineage: empty state when the notebook has no SQL cells.

lineage_none.location: SQL notebook → left rail Lineage and inspector Dependencies: placeholder when a cell reads from or is used by no other cell.

lineage_tab.location: SQL notebook → left rail: tab that lists which cells each SQL cell reads from and feeds.

named_cell.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Outline: second line marking an entry that is a named cell rather than a heading.

outline_empty.value: Добавьте заголовки Markdown или задайте имена ячейкам, чтобы построить структуру.
outline_empty.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Outline: empty state.

outline_tab.location: SQL notebook → left rail: tab listing Markdown headings and named cells; also the label on the collapsed rail.

parameters_empty.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Parameters: empty state before any parameter is added.

parameters_tab.location: SQL notebook → left rail: tab with the notebook's @parameters and their values.

search_hit.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Search: result heading naming the cell and the line that matched.

search_no_results.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Search: shown when no cell matches the search text.

search_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Search: placeholder of the search field.

search_tab.location: SQL notebook → left rail: tab that searches the SQL and text of every cell.

variable_detail.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Variables: second line under a named cell with its type and run state.

variables_empty.value: Задайте имя ячейке в инспекторе, чтобы использовать её как переменную.
variables_empty.location: SQL notebook → left rail → Variables: empty state when no cell has a name.

variables_tab.location: SQL notebook → left rail: tab listing the named cells other cells can reference.

choose.location: SQL notebook → connection remap prompt: button that opens the list of this computer's connections for one missing connection.

reference_with_database.location: SQL notebook → connection remap prompt: a missing connection with the database it used.

skip.location: SQL notebook → connection remap prompt: button that closes the prompt without choosing connections.

title.value: Этот блокнот использует подключения, которых нет на этом компьютере. Выберите для каждого одно из своих:
title.location: SQL notebook → connection remap prompt: heading shown when a notebook from another computer references connections that do not exist here.

unresolved_run.value: Перед выполнением этой ячейки выберите локальное подключение для {connection_name}.
unresolved_run.location: SQL notebook → status bar and cell: error shown when a cell's saved connection does not exist on this computer.

above.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs every SQL cell above the selected cell.

all.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs every SQL cell in order.

below.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs the selected cell and every SQL cell below it.

cell.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs only the selected cell.

cell_missing.location: SQL notebook → status bar: error shown when a run refers to a cell that was deleted.

cell_with_upstream.value: Выполнить ячейку и устаревшие входные данные
cell_with_upstream.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs the cells the selected cell reads from that are out of date, then the cell.

downstream.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs the selected cell and every cell that reads from it.

no_active_cell.location: SQL notebook → status bar: shown when a run that needs a selected cell is started with no cell selected.

not_started.value: Ячейка не запустилась. Причина указана в строке состояния.
not_started.location: SQL notebook → cell and Activity panel: shown when the query could not be started for a reason reported elsewhere.

nothing_to_run.location: SQL notebook → status bar: shown when the chosen run covers no SQL cells (or every cell is already fresh).

selected.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs the cells selected with Shift-click.

stale.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: runs every SQL cell that never ran or whose inputs changed since it ran.

validate_only.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Run menu: checks every SQL cell's references and safety without running anything.

validated_ok.location: SQL notebook → status bar and Activity panel: result of Check Without Running when every cell is fine.

validated_problems.location: SQL notebook → status bar and Activity panel: result of Check Without Running when some cells have problems.

all_completed.location: SQL notebook → status bar and Activity panel: message after running every cell finishes; {count} is how many cells ran.

validated_ok_one.location: SQL notebook → status bar and Activity panel: result of Check Without Running when every cell is fine. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

validated_problems_one.value: В {count} ячейке есть проблемы. См. панель «Активность».
validated_problems_one.location: SQL notebook → status bar and Activity panel: result of Check Without Running when some cells have problems. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

all_completed_one.location: SQL notebook → status bar and Activity panel: message after running every cell finishes; {count} is how many cells ran. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

allow_writes_button.location: SQL notebook → cell header: button shown on a read-only cell whose SQL changes data; asks for confirmation before allowing it.

allow_writes_cancel.location: SQL notebook → Allow writes confirmation: button that closes the dialog and leaves the cell read-only.

allow_writes_confirm.location: SQL notebook → Allow writes confirmation: button that lets the cell run statements that change data.

allow_writes_detail.value: Инструкции, изменяющие данные, по-прежнему проходят проверку изменений перед выполнением.
allow_writes_detail.location: SQL notebook → Allow writes confirmation: explanation under the target connection.

allow_writes_production.location: SQL notebook → Allow writes confirmation: warning shown when the cell runs on a production connection.

allow_writes_target.location: SQL notebook → Allow writes confirmation: the connection the cell would change data on, followed by its environment badge.

allow_writes_title.location: SQL notebook → Allow writes confirmation: dialog title; {cell_name} is the cell's name or id.

make_read_only_button.location: SQL notebook → cell header: button shown on a cell allowed to write that puts it back into read-only mode.

read_only_badge.location: SQL notebook → cell header: badge on a cell that runs in the database's read-only mode.

read_only_blocks_writes.value: Эта ячейка только для чтения, а её SQL изменяет данные. Выберите «Разрешить запись», чтобы выполнить её.
read_only_blocks_writes.location: SQL notebook → cell and status bar: error shown when a read-only cell whose SQL changes data is run.

review_target.location: SQL notebook → Change review dialog: summary line naming the connection and environment the cell writes to, followed by the usual summary.

writes_allowed_badge.location: SQL notebook → cell header: badge on a cell that is allowed to run statements that change data.

awaiting_approval.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose statements wait in the change review dialog.

blocked.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell that could not run because a cell it reads from failed or the run was refused.

canceled.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose run was stopped.

failed.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose last run failed.

fresh.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose result matches its current SQL, inputs and connection.

idle.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell that has not run in this session.

queued.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell waiting in the run queue.

running.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose query is running.

stale.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose result no longer matches its SQL, inputs or connection.

cached.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell showing a cached result that still matches its inputs.

partial.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose result is incomplete.

streaming.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell whose rows are arriving.

unavailable.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell that cannot run in this build or on this computer.

validating.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell being checked without running.

waiting.location: SQL notebook → cell header, inspector and Variables: state of a cell waiting for the cells it reads from.

autosave_files.location: SQL notebook → top bar → More menu: checkable item that saves the notebook to its file automatically as it changes.

autosaved.location: SQL notebook → top bar: save state shown after the notebook was saved automatically.

connection_label.location: SQL notebook → top bar: button showing the notebook's default connection; opens the connection picker.

connection_tooltip.value: Подключение для ячеек, у которых не выбрано собственное
connection_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip of the notebook connection button.

convert_to_script.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Export menu: opens the notebook's SQL as one script in a new query tab.

export.location: SQL notebook → top bar: menu button with Markdown, Jupyter and SQL script exports.

export_jupyter.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Export menu: item that saves a copy of the notebook as a Jupyter .ipynb file that Azure Data Studio, VS Code and Jupyter open; keep “Jupyter” unchanged.

export_markdown.location: SQL notebook → top bar → Export menu: item that saves a copy of the notebook as a Markdown file.

more.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip and accessible name of the overflow menu button (Save As, Autosave to File).

presentation.location: SQL notebook → top bar: button that presents the notebook's dashboard full screen, one section at a time.

presentation_tooltip.value: Показать дашборд на весь экран, по одному разделу
presentation_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip of the Present button.

recovered.location: SQL notebook → top bar: save state of an unsaved notebook reopened from its automatic recovery copy.

run_all.location: SQL notebook → top bar: button that runs every cell in dependency order.

run_cell.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip and accessible name of the play button that runs the selected cell.

run_menu.location: SQL notebook → top bar: menu button with every way to run cells (cell, inputs, all, stale, dependents, above, below, selected, check).

run_mode_cell.location: SQL notebook → top bar: run mode button when running a cell runs only that cell.

run_mode_tooltip.value: Что входит в выполнение ячейки; нажмите, чтобы переключить
run_mode_tooltip.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip of the run mode button.

run_mode_upstream.value: Режим: ячейка и устаревшие входные данные
run_mode_upstream.location: SQL notebook → top bar: run mode button when running a cell first runs the out-of-date cells it reads from.

save.location: SQL notebook → top bar: button that saves the notebook.

save_as.location: SQL notebook → top bar → More menu: item that saves the notebook under a new name or location.

saved.location: SQL notebook → top bar: save state when every change is saved.

stop.location: SQL notebook → top bar: button shown while cells run that stops the remaining queued cells.

title_placeholder.location: SQL notebook → top bar: placeholder of the notebook title field.

toggle_activity.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip and accessible name of the button that toggles the bottom activity panel.

toggle_inspector.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip and accessible name of the button that toggles the right inspector.

toggle_left_rail.location: SQL notebook → top bar: tooltip and accessible name of the button that toggles the left rail.

unsaved.location: SQL notebook → top bar: save state when the notebook has changes not yet saved.

run_blocked.value: Прежде чем выполнять ячейки, отметьте этот блокнот как доверенный.
run_blocked.location: SQL notebook → status bar: error shown when a cell is run in a notebook that is not trusted yet.

trust_button.location: SQL notebook → trust banner: button that allows this notebook's cells to run.

pending.value: Этому блокноту пока не разрешено использовать эти подключения: {connections}.
pending.location: SQL notebook → trust banner: shown when some of a trusted notebook's connections still need allowing; {connections} lists their names.

read_only_banner.value: Доверие только для чтения: ячейки, изменяющие данные, не будут выполняться.
read_only_banner.location: SQL notebook → trust banner: shown for a notebook trusted for read-only runs only.

allow_button.location: SQL notebook → trust banner: button that opens the trust dialog to allow the connections still waiting.

change_button.location: SQL notebook → trust banner: button that opens the trust dialog to change how far the notebook is trusted.

connection_not_allowed.value: Подключение этой ячейки пока не разрешено для этого блокнота ({connection_name}). Снова доверьтесь блокноту и отметьте это подключение, чтобы выполнить ячейку.
connection_not_allowed.location: SQL notebook → trust banner and cell message: a cell did not run because its connection was not allowed, or was remapped since the notebook was trusted; {connection_name} is the connection's name.

current_connection.location: SQL notebook → trust banner and trust dialog: name of the notebook tab's own connection, which cells without a connection of their own use.

moved.value: Вы доверились этому блокноту в другом месте на этом компьютере.
moved.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged when a trusted notebook is opened from a different place than the one it was trusted at.

activity_read_only.value: Блокноту доверено выполнение только для чтения
activity_read_only.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: entry logged after the user trusted a notebook for read-only runs.

dialog_title.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: title of the dialog that trusts a notebook and chooses its connections.

dialog_intro.value: Сначала прочитайте его SQL. Ячейки выполняются только на отмеченных подключениях и только пока запросы и подключения блокнота остаются такими, как сейчас.
dialog_intro.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: explanation under the title.

connections_heading.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: heading above the list of the notebook's connections, each with a checkbox.

mapped_to.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: line under a notebook connection naming the local connection it maps to; {connection_name} is that connection's name.

not_mapped.value: Пока не сопоставлено с подключением на этом компьютере
not_mapped.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: line under a notebook connection that maps to no connection on this computer.

no_connections.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: shown instead of the connection list when the notebook uses no connections.

level_trusted.value: Доверять: ячейки могут выполняться на отмеченных подключениях
level_trusted.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: option that fully trusts the notebook on the ticked connections.

level_read_only.value: Доверие только для чтения: выполняются только ячейки, не изменяющие данные
level_read_only.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: option that trusts the notebook for read-only runs only.

allow_writes.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: checkbox that lets the notebook's cells that change data run.

cancel_button.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: button that closes the dialog without trusting the notebook.

confirm_button.location: SQL notebook → trust dialog: button that trusts the notebook with the chosen connections.

scan_refused.value: Этот блокнот не открыт, так как он может быть небезопасен: {reasons}
scan_refused.location: SQL notebook → Opening a notebook file (open, recent files, session restore, recovery, browser): error shown when the safety scan blocks the file before it is opened; {reasons} lists what the scan found.

title.value: Проверка безопасности SQLLY нашла в этом файле то, на что стоит обратить внимание:
title.location: SQL notebook → banner under the top bar: heading over the warnings the safety scan found when the file opened (it still opened).

dismiss.location: SQL notebook → safety scan banner: button that hides the banner.

activity.location: SQL notebook → activity panel: entry for one warning of the safety scan when the file opened; {warning} is the warning text.

file_type.location: Browser version → Notebook → Open Notebook and Save As file choosers: name of the notebook file type the browser's file chooser lists.

file_failed.location: Browser version → Notebook → Open Notebook or Save: status-bar error when the browser could not read or write a notebook file on the computer; {error} is the browser's reason.

opened.value: Открыт файл {file_name}. Копия хранится в этом браузере.
opened.location: Browser version → Notebook → Open Notebook: status-bar message after a notebook file from the computer opened; {file_name} is the file's name.

too_large.value: Файл больше {limit_mb} МБ — это максимальный размер блокнота, который открывает SQLLY.
too_large.location: Browser version → Notebook → Open Notebook: status-bar error when the chosen file is too big to open; {limit_mb} is the size limit in megabytes.

session_only.value: Этот браузер не разрешает SQLLY хранить данные, поэтому они сохранятся только до закрытия вкладки.
session_only.location: Browser version → Notebook → Open, Save or Save As: sentence added to the status message when the browser refuses to keep site data (for example a private window), so notebooks last only until the tab closes.

write_failed.value: Не удалось сохранить блокнот в этом браузере: {error}
write_failed.location: Browser version → Notebook → Open or Save As: status-bar error when the notebook could not be kept in the browser's storage; {error} is the reason.

saved_in_browser.location: Browser version → Notebook → Save: status-bar message after Save updated the notebook's copy in this browser (no file on the computer is linked); {file_name} is the notebook's file name.

downloaded.value: Файл {file_name} скачан. Копия хранится в этом браузере, и «Сохранить» обновляет её.
downloaded.location: Browser version → Notebook → Save As in a browser that can't choose a save location: status-bar message after the notebook was downloaded; {file_name} is the downloaded file's name.

saved_to_file.location: Browser version → Notebook → Save or Save As: status-bar message after the notebook was written to the file on the computer that the browser gave SQLLY access to; {file_name} is the file's name.

file_not_written.value: Сохранено в этом браузере, но файл {file_name} на компьютере не обновлён: {error}
file_not_written.location: Browser version → Notebook → Save: status-bar warning when the browser copy was saved but the linked file on the computer could not be written; {file_name} is the file's name and {error} the reason.

permission.value: Браузер не разрешил запись в файл.
permission.location: Browser version → Notebook → Save: reason shown when the browser did not allow SQLLY to write to the notebook's file on the computer.

no_handle.value: Файл больше не открыт на этой странице. Выберите его снова через «Сохранить как».
no_handle.location: Browser version → Notebook → Save: reason shown when the page lost access to the notebook's file on the computer (for example after a reload), telling the user how to pick it again.

done.location: Browser version → Notebook → Export menu → any format: status-bar message after the export was downloaded; {file_name} lists the downloaded files.

fidelity.location: Browser version → Notebook → Export menu → a report format: sentence added to the download status listing what the chosen format can't show; {notes} is a semicolon-separated list.

format_unavailable.location: Browser version → Notebook → Export menu → PDF or PNG, or a chart cell's PNG export: feature name completing the “not available in the browser” sentence; {format} is the format's name, such as PDF.

removed.location: Browser version → Notebook → Export menu → any format: sentence added to the download status listing what redaction removed or masked; {items} is a semicolon-separated list.

confirm.value: {reason} Выберите тот же экспорт ещё раз, чтобы скачать его без этих значений.
confirm.location: Browser version → Notebook → Export menu → any format: status-bar warning when the notebook holds sensitive data; {reason} explains what will be left out, and the text says to choose the export again to go ahead.

local_data.value: Запуск ячеек на локальных данных блокнота недоступен
local_data.location: Browser version → Notebook → SQL cell set to run on the notebook's local data: feature name completing the “not available in the browser” sentence shown on the cell.

transform.location: Browser version → Notebook → transform cell: feature name completing the “not available in the browser” sentence shown on the cell, since transforms run on the notebook's local data.

attachment.location: Browser version → Notebook → attachment cell: feature name completing the “not available in the browser” sentence shown on the cell, since attachments read files on the computer.

export.location: Browser version → Notebook → export cell: feature name completing the “not available in the browser” sentence shown on the cell, since export cells write files on the computer.

outputs.value: Сохранение результатов ячеек в истории запусков недоступно
outputs.location: Browser version → Notebook → left rail → History: feature name completing the “not available in the browser” sentence explaining that runs are listed but their results are not kept.

needs_field.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that uses a date-range parameter without picking one of its fields; {name} is the parameter name.

param.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell when a parameter it uses has an unacceptable value; {name} is the parameter name and {error} is the reason.

secret_needs_native_binding.value: {name} — секрет, поэтому его можно передать только как параметр драйвера, но не вписать в SQL
secret_needs_native_binding.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that would write a secret parameter's value into the SQL text; {name} is the parameter name.

timezone_unsupported.value: {name}: эта база данных не может прочитать часовой пояс {tz} в литерале; используйте смещение от UTC
timezone_unsupported.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell when a date-time parameter's time zone cannot be written as a literal for this database; {name} is the parameter name and {tz} the time zone.

unknown_field.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that reads a field a parameter does not have; {name} is the parameter name and {field} the field as written.

loop.value: Эти ячейки циклически зависят друг от друга: {path}
loop.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown when cells reference each other in a circle; {path} is the chain of cell names joined by arrows.

remove_reference.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: suggested fix shown with a loop error; {upstream} is the cell being referenced and {dependent} the cell whose reference should be removed.

cte_name_conflict.value: Имя {name} используется более чем одной из ячеек: {cells}
cte_name_conflict.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell when two referenced cells would become CTEs with the same name; {name} is the name and {cells} the list of cells involved.

empty.value: Ячейка {cell} пуста, поэтому её нельзя использовать как таблицу
empty.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that selects from another cell when the referenced cell has no SQL; {cell} is the referenced cell's name or id.

multiple_statements.value: Ячейка {cell} содержит больше одной инструкции, поэтому её нельзя использовать как таблицу
multiple_statements.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that selects from another cell when the referenced cell holds several statements; {cell} is the referenced cell's name or id.

not_a_query.value: Ячейка {cell} не является запросом, поэтому её нельзя использовать как таблицу
not_a_query.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that selects from another cell when the referenced cell does not start with SELECT, WITH or a parenthesis; {cell} is the referenced cell's name or id.

not_a_relation.value: У ячейки {referenced} нет таблицы для выборки
not_a_relation.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that selects from a Markdown, parameter or layout cell; {referenced} is that cell's name or id.

not_read_only.value: Ячейка {cell} не является запросом только для чтения, поэтому её нельзя использовать как таблицу
not_read_only.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that selects from another cell when the referenced cell could change data; {cell} is the referenced cell's name or id.

not_sql.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown when SQL expansion is requested for a cell that is not a SQL cell; {cell} is that cell's name or id.

references_span_statements.value: Ячейка {cell} использует другие ячейки в нескольких операторах; оставьте ссылки в одном операторе
references_span_statements.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that holds several statements when more than one of them selects from another cell with {{name}}; the referenced cells can only be added in front of one statement. {cell} is the cell's name or id.

trailing_clause.value: Ячейка {cell} заканчивается предложением, недопустимым в CTE, поэтому её нельзя использовать как таблицу
trailing_clause.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that selects from another cell when the referenced cell ends with a clause such as FOR XML or FOR JSON; {cell} is the referenced cell's name or id.

unknown_cell.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown when the cell being expanded into SQL no longer exists in the notebook; {id} is the cell id.

unknown_reference.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell when one of the cells it references does not exist; {token} is the reference as written.

unsupported_with.value: Ячейка {cell} начинается с предложения WITH, которое нельзя объединить, поэтому её нельзя использовать как таблицу
unsupported_with.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a SQL cell that selects from another cell when the referenced cell starts with a WITH clause that cannot be merged into the outer query; {cell} is the referenced cell's name or id.

unknown_cell.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a cell when a double-brace reference in its text names no cell; {token} is the reference as written.

unknown_input.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a cell whose configured input cell is missing from the notebook; {input} is the input cell as written.

unknown_options_cell.value: Ячейка {cell}, из которой берутся варианты этого параметра, не существует
unknown_options_cell.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown when the cell that supplies a parameter's list of options is missing; {cell} is that cell as written in the parameter.

unknown_parameter.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown under a cell that uses a parameter the notebook does not define; {name} is the parameter name as written.

invalid_document.location: SQL notebook → Status bar when opening a notebook file: shown when the file is JSON but its notebook content is malformed; {detail} is the technical reason.

invalid_json.value: Файл блокнота не является корректным JSON: {detail}
invalid_json.location: SQL notebook → Status bar when opening a notebook file: shown when the file cannot be parsed as JSON; {detail} is the parser's description of the problem.

newer_format.value: Этот блокнот создан более новой версией SQLLY (формат {found}; эта версия читает до {supported}). Обновите SQLLY, чтобы открыть его.
newer_format.location: SQL notebook → Status bar when opening a notebook file: shown when the file uses a newer notebook format; {found} is the file's format number and {supported} the highest this version reads.

not_a_notebook.value: Этот файл не является блокнотом, который может открыть SQLLY
not_a_notebook.location: SQL notebook → Status bar when opening a notebook file: shown when the chosen file is valid JSON but is neither a SQLLY notebook nor a Jupyter notebook.

unsupported_ipynb.value: Формат блокнота Jupyter {nbformat} не поддерживается; сохраните его в формате 4
unsupported_ipynb.location: SQL notebook → Status bar when opening a notebook file: shown when opening a Jupyter .ipynb file in an old format; {nbformat} is the file's format number.

collides_with_cell_id.value: Это имя совпадает с идентификатором ячейки {other}
collides_with_cell_id.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when the new cell name is spelled like another cell's id; {other} is that cell's id.

collides_with_cell_name.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when a parameter is renamed to a name or id a cell already uses; {other} is that cell's id.

collides_with_parameter.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when the new name matches an existing parameter; {name} is that parameter's name.

duplicate.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when another cell already has the new name (ignoring case); {other} is that cell's id.

not_identifier.value: Используйте буквы, цифры и подчёркивания; имя должно начинаться с буквы или подчёркивания
not_identifier.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when the new cell or parameter name is not a valid identifier.

reserved.value: Это слово зарезервировано в SQL; выберите другое имя
reserved.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when the new cell or parameter name is a SQL reserved word.

unknown_cell.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when the cell being renamed no longer exists; {id} is the cell id.

unknown_parameter.location: SQL notebook → Status bar after renaming in the inspector: shown when the parameter being renamed no longer exists; {name} is its old name.

identifier_not_allowed.value: Выберите имя из списка разрешённых для параметра
identifier_not_allowed.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when an identifier parameter's value is not one of the names it permits.

invalid_value.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when the typed text cannot be read as the parameter's type; {expected} is the type name, such as integer or date.

missing.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a parameter has no value and no default.

not_allowed.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when the value is not one of the parameter's listed choices.

off_step.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a slider parameter's value falls between the slider's step positions.

out_of_range.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a number or date value is below the minimum or above the maximum.

preset_not_applicable.value: Предустановка {preset} не подходит для типа этого параметра
preset_not_applicable.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a default preset such as a relative date is used on a parameter of another type; {preset} is the preset name.

required.value: Этот параметр не может быть пустым
required.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a required parameter's value was cleared.

too_long.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a text value exceeds the parameter's maximum length.

too_short.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a text value is shorter than the parameter's minimum length.

unknown_preset.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown when a parameter's default names a preset SQLLY does not know; {preset} is the preset name as written.

unsupported_type.value: Эта версия SQLLY не поддерживает параметры типа {kind}
unsupported_type.location: SQL notebook → Parameters rail, next to a parameter value: shown for a parameter whose type comes from a newer SQLLY; {kind} is the type name as saved in the file.

parameter.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown for a cell that cannot run because a parameter it uses has an unacceptable value; {name} is the parameter name and {error} the reason.

unknown_cell.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown when a run was requested for a cell that has since been deleted.

unsupported_kind.value: Эта версия SQLLY не может выполнять ячейки типа {kind}
unsupported_kind.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown for a cell of a kind this version cannot run, such as Python or a kind from a newer SQLLY; {kind} is the cell kind.

upstream_blocked.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown for a cell that depends on another cell that is itself blocked; {cell} is the blocked upstream cell.

upstream_not_current.value: У ячейки {cell} нет актуального результата; сначала выполните её или выполните вместе с входными данными
upstream_not_current.location: SQL notebook → Cell error and Activity panel: shown for a cell that reads another cell's output when that output is missing or out of date; {cell} is the upstream cell.

duplicate.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: shown when saving a run to the notebook's run history finds that run id already stored; {run_id} is the run id.

io.value: Не удалось прочитать или записать историю запусков: {detail}
io.location: SQL notebook → Activity panel: shown when the notebook's run history cannot be read from or saved to disk; {detail} is the system error.

generated.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (HTML, PDF, Markdown, Excel): label before the date and time the report was produced, on the cover and in the page header.

author.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label on the cover before the name of the team or person the report is from.

notebook.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label on the cover before the notebook's id.

version.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label on the cover and in the footer before the notebook version hash the report was run from.

parameters.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label on the cover before each parameter name and value the report was run with.

connections.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label on the cover before each database connection the report read from.

environment.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Provenance: label before the environment (production, staging) a result came from.

production.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: tag after a connection name on the cover when the connection is a production database.

database.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Provenance: label before the database a result was read from.

contents.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (HTML): heading of the table of contents near the top of the page.

page_of.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (PDF): page number in the footer of every page; {page} is this page and {pages} the page count.

complete.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (Excel) → Summary sheet: status of a table whose rows are all included.

truncated.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: badge next to a table or chart whose query stopped at the row limit; {count} is the limit.

spilled.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: badge next to a table whose result was larger than what the report holds; {count} is the full row count.

sampled.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: badge next to a table or chart built from a sample; {count} is the sample size.

partial.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: badge next to a table whose query was canceled or failed part way.

derived_partial.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: badge next to a table whose query returned every row but used a scalar value that was computed from truncated, sampled or partial data.

rows_shown.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: note under a table that shows only its first rows; {shown} rows of {total} are printed.

data_withheld.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: notice in place of a table's rows or a chart when the report was exported without data.

no_rows.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: note under a table whose query returned no rows.

callout_fact.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label at the top of a note stating something read directly from a result.

callout_derived.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label at the top of a note stating something computed from results.

callout_hypothesis.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label at the top of a note offering a possible explanation that is not yet proven.

callout_recommendation.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label at the top of a note recommending an action.

callout_warning.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label at the top of a warning note.

callout_note.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label at the top of a general note.

evidence.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label under a note before the run or cell ids the statement is based on.

assertion_passed.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: status pill on a data check that passed.

assertion_failed.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: status pill on a data check that failed.

assertion_warning.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: status pill on a data check that passed with a warning.

assertion_error.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: status pill on a data check that could not run.

assertion_skipped.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: status pill on a data check that was skipped.

assertion_inconclusive.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: status of a check that could not decide (for example because its input was incomplete); the reason follows it.

expected.value: Ожидалось
expected.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label before the value a data check expected.

actual.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label before the value a data check found.

provenance.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: accessible name of the block listing where a result came from.

cell.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Provenance: label before the id of the notebook cell a result came from.

run.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Provenance: label before the id of the run that produced a result.

connection.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Provenance: label before the connection name a result was read from.

extracted.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Provenance: label before the time the rows were read from the database.

sql_hash.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Provenance: label before the fingerprint of the SQL text that produced a result.

rows.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: label or column heading before a row count (provenance, Excel summary sheet index).

appendix_sql.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: heading of the appendix that lists the SQL behind each result.

appendix_provenance.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: heading of the appendix that lists where each result came from.

compared_with.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → KPI card: end of the change line naming what the value is compared with; {label} is that comparison, such as last week.

status_good.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → KPI card: status shown when the value meets its target.

status_warning.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → KPI card: status shown when the value is close to its limit.

status_critical.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → KPI card: status shown when the value misses its target.

status_neutral.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → KPI card: status shown when the value has no judgment.

other.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Charts: name of the slice, bar or series that groups the remaining categories.

total.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Waterfall chart: label of the final bar showing the running total.

null_value.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report → Charts: category label for rows whose value is empty (NULL).

redacted.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: text that replaces a sensitive value removed from the report.

summary_sheet.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (Excel): name of the first sheet that summarizes the report.

sheet_contents.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (Excel) → Summary sheet: heading of the list of data sheets in the workbook.

name_column.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: generic column heading for a name.

value_column.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: generic column heading for a value.

status.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (Excel) → Summary sheet: column heading for each sheet's completeness, and the cover label before the data notice.

image_unavailable.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: note shown in place of an image that could not be included safely in this format.

chart_unavailable.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: text in place of a chart that could not be drawn; {reason} explains why.

chart_no_data.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: text in place of a chart whose result has no rows to plot.

export_notes.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report (Excel) → Summary sheet: heading of the list of things this format could not show.

kpi_target.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: KPI card, name of the comparison when a KPI is compared with a fixed target.

kpi_baseline.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: KPI card, name of the comparison when a KPI is compared with a baseline result.

kpi_previous.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: KPI card, name of the comparison with the previous period when the period has no label.

kpi_incomplete.value: Вычислено по неполным данным; статус не указан.
kpi_incomplete.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: note under a KPI whose input was truncated, sampled or stopped early, so its status is not shown.

failing_rows.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: message next to a failed check; {count} is how many rows failed it.

check_name.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: name of a check that has none of its own; {cell} is the assertion cell's name and {number} the check's position in it.

run_subtitle.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: subtitle naming the run the report comes from; {run} is the run id and {started} when it started (UTC).

chart.location: Notebook → Export → Excel workbook: name of a chart picture that has no title.

failing_rows_one.location: Notebook → Export → Exported report: message next to a failed check; {count} is how many rows failed it. This form is shown when the count is exactly 1.

unknown_column.value: Диаграмма использует столбец, которого нет в результате: {column}.
unknown_column.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when the chart refers to a column the result does not have; {column} is that column.

missing_x.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when no column is chosen for the x axis.

missing_y.value: Выберите хотя бы один столбец для показателя.
missing_y.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when no column is chosen as the measure.

missing_series.value: Выберите столбец для разделения диаграммы на ряды.
missing_series.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when a heatmap or cohort chart has no column to split rows into series.

missing_size.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when a bubble chart has no column for the bubble size.

not_numeric.value: {column} не является числовым столбцом, поэтому его нельзя использовать как показатель.
not_numeric.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when a text column is used where the chart needs numbers; {column} is that column.

not_temporal.value: {column} не является столбцом даты или времени.
not_temporal.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when a date grain or calendar chart uses a column that is not a date; {column} is that column.

too_many_measures.value: Этот тип диаграммы показывает один показатель; уберите лишние столбцы.
too_many_measures.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when a pie, funnel, histogram or similar chart is given more than one measure.

series_not_supported.value: Этот тип диаграммы нельзя разделить на ряды.
series_not_supported.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when a series column is set on a chart type that cannot split into series.

invalid_top_n.value: Топ-N должен оставлять хотя бы одну категорию.
invalid_top_n.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when the top-N setting would keep no categories.

invalid_bins.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when a histogram's bin count is out of range.

invalid_axis_range.value: Минимум оси должен быть меньше максимума.
invalid_axis_range.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when the axis minimum is not below the axis maximum.

band_needs_line.value: Полосу ожидаемого диапазона можно рисовать только на линейной диаграмме или диаграмме с областями.
band_needs_line.location: Notebook → Chart cell: error when an expected-range band is set on a chart that is not a line or area chart.

static_charts.value: Диаграммы и таблицы статичны: подсказки, масштаб и сортировка недоступны.
static_charts.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that charts and tables in the file cannot be hovered, zoomed or sorted.

cross_filter_dropped.value: Связанные ячейки больше не фильтруют друг друга.
cross_filter_dropped.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that linked cells no longer filter each other in the file.

charts_as_images.value: Диаграммы встроены как изображения, а не как редактируемые диаграммы.
charts_as_images.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes (Excel): note that charts are embedded as pictures.

charts_as_data.value: В этом формате диаграммы не рисуются; вместо них включены их данные.
charts_as_data.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that this format has no charts and carries their data instead.

chart_failed.value: Одну диаграмму не удалось нарисовать, вместо неё показано примечание.
chart_failed.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that a chart could not be drawn.

columns_stacked.value: Колонки панели показаны одна под другой.
columns_stacked.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that dashboard columns are placed one under another.

rows_capped.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that a table prints only its first rows; {shown} of {total} rows.

glyphs_missing.value: Символов без начертания в шрифте PDF: {count}; они показаны квадратами (например, {sample}).
glyphs_missing.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes (PDF): note that some characters, often Chinese, Japanese or Korean, have no glyph in the PDF font; {count} characters such as {sample}.

complex_scripts.value: Письменности справа налево и со связным начертанием рисуются по буквам и могут читаться неправильно.
complex_scripts.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes (PDF): note that right-to-left and joined scripts may not render correctly.

precision_rounded.value: Excel хранит 15 значащих цифр, поэтому часть значений в {column} округлена.
precision_rounded.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes (Excel): note that decimals with more than 15 significant digits are rounded; {column} is the column.

large_integers_as_text.value: Целые числа в {column} слишком велики для числа Excel и записаны как текст.
large_integers_as_text.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes (Excel): note that very large integers were written as text to keep every digit; {column} is the column.

non_finite_as_text.value: Значения NaN и бесконечности в {column} записаны как текст.
non_finite_as_text.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes (Excel): note that NaN and infinite values were written as text; {column} is the column.

image_dropped.value: Изображение пропущено: оно небезопасно или не поддерживается в этом формате.
image_dropped.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that an image was left out because it was unsafe or unsupported.

html_removed.value: Из текстовых ячеек удалено фрагментов HTML: {count}.
html_removed.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that raw HTML in text cells was removed; {count} pieces.

links_removed.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that links with unsafe targets were removed; {count} links.

external_images_removed.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that images loading from the internet were removed; {count} images.

page_breaks_ignored.value: В этом формате разрывы страниц не учитываются.
page_breaks_ignored.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that page breaks have no effect in this format.

cell_text_truncated.value: Длинный текст ячеек сокращён, чтобы поместиться на странице.
cell_text_truncated.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that long cell text was shortened.

layout_flattened.value: Заголовки, карточки и примечания перечислены обычными строками.
layout_flattened.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that headings, KPI cards and notes become plain rows in this format.

rich_text_flattened.value: Форматирование текста, например жирный шрифт и ссылки, показано как обычный текст.
rich_text_flattened.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that bold, links and other text formatting become plain text.

columns_omitted.value: Таблица показывает {shown} из {total} столбцов, чтобы поместиться на странице.
columns_omitted.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes (PDF): note that a wide table drops columns that do not fit the page; {shown} of {total} columns.

fixed_theme.value: Цвета закреплены за одной темой и не следуют светлому или тёмному режиму.
fixed_theme.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that colors in the file are fixed to one theme.

categories_capped.value: В диаграмме слишком много категорий; {count} из них объединены в «Другое».
categories_capped.location: Notebook → Export dialog → Export notes: note that a chart had more categories than it can draw and grouped the rest under Other; {count} is how many categories were grouped.

incomplete_data.value: Некоторые таблицы или диаграммы содержат лишь часть результата запроса (усечённого, выборочного или прерванного).
