unsupported_object.value: Этот объект нельзя добавить в корзину развёртывания
unsupported_object.location: Explorer → Context menu → Deploy Cart: status-bar warning shown when the right-clicked object type cannot be added to a deploy cart.

ddl_split_unavailable.value: Вкладку просмотра DDL нельзя разделить на два вида
ddl_split_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when the user tries to split the editor while a read-only DDL viewer tab is active; DDL viewers cannot be split.

format_shortcut_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Format SQL icon button: tooltip when a keyboard shortcut is assigned; {shortcut} is the key combination (for example ⌘⇧F). Reformats the current query.

format_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Format SQL icon button: tooltip shown when no keyboard shortcut is assigned to formatting; the button reformats the current query.

gesture_zoom_status.location: Workbench → editor trackpad or touch gesture: status showing the updated zoom percentage in {percent}.

refresh_schema_age_tooltip.value: Обновить схему — в последний раз загружена {age}
refresh_schema_age_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Refresh schema icon button: tooltip when a cached schema exists; {age} is how long ago it was fetched (for example “5 minutes ago”). Reloads the object explorer and IntelliSense catalog.

refresh_schema_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Refresh schema icon button: tooltip shown when no cached schema exists yet for the connection; the button reloads the object explorer and IntelliSense catalog.

save_shortcut_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Save icon button: tooltip when a keyboard shortcut is assigned; {shortcut} is the key combination (for example ⌘S). Saves the current query to a file.

save_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Save icon button: tooltip shown when no keyboard shortcut is assigned to saving; the button saves the current query to a file.

zoom_status.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown after the editor zoom level is changed with the zoom slider, zoom shortcuts or Reset Zoom; reports the new zoom level as a percentage.

new_query_button.location: Workbench → Empty state (no tabs open): button below the shortcut hint that opens a new blank query tab.

new_query_shortcut.value: Нажмите {shortcut}, чтобы открыть новое окно запроса.
new_query_shortcut.location: Workbench → Empty state (no tabs open): dimmed hint under the “No query open” heading; {shortcut} is the key combination for New Query (for example ⌘N).

no_query.location: Workbench → Empty state (no tabs open): large heading under the SQLLY logo shown when every query tab has been closed.

agent_grant_mismatch.value: Право агента на запись не совпало — ничего не выполнено
agent_grant_mismatch.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when SQL proposed by the AI assistant or an MCP agent no longer matches the write approval it was granted (edited text or different connection), so the run was refused and nothing executed.

ai_review_ready_run.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the required AI review of a data-changing query has finished, telling the user to confirm in the data-change review dialog to run the query.

ai_review_ready_save.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the required AI review of staged grid edits has finished, telling the user to confirm in the review dialog to save the changes to the database.

ai_review_unavailable.value: Проверка ИИ недоступна — запрос не выполнен: {error}
ai_review_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the AI review required before a data change could not be generated, so the pending review is dropped and the query is not run; {error} is the AI provider’s error text.

auto_refresh_disabled_not_select.value: Автообновление отключено: последний оператор не только SELECT
auto_refresh_disabled_not_select.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a query tab’s auto-refresh timer fires on SQL whose last statement changes data, so auto-refresh is switched off for that tab instead of re-running it.

auto_refresh_multi_target.value: Автообновление не выполняется на нескольких целях
auto_refresh_multi_target.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a query tab with auto-refresh turned on is run on several connections at once; auto-refresh only works with a single connection.

confirm_mutation.location: Workbench → Status bar: short info prompt shown when a single-connection query that changes data opens the data-change review dialog (no AI review required); asks the user to confirm or cancel the change.

count_cte_unsupported.value: Подсчёт общего количества невозможен для запроса с CTE
count_cte_unsupported.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is used on a query starting with a WITH common table expression, which cannot be wrapped in a COUNT query.

count_review_pending.value: Невозможно подсчитать общее количество строк, пока ожидается проверка изменения.
count_review_pending.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is clicked while a data-change review for the same tab is still awaiting confirmation.

count_single_statement.value: Для подсчёта общего количества нужен один запрос SELECT
count_single_statement.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is used on SQL containing more than one statement; counting requires exactly one SELECT.

generating_ai_review.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy progress message shown after a single-connection data-changing query opens the review dialog while the required AI explanation of the change is being generated.

log_cancelled.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when the running query reports that it was cancelled; standalone past-participle status, one word in English.

log_completed.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when a query finishes on the server; {milliseconds} is the elapsed execution time in milliseconds.

log_database_changed.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when a statement (such as USE) switches the session’s current database; {database} is the new database name.

log_default_database.location: Workbench → execution log: database value substituted in the query-start entry when the active connection has no explicit database.

log_executing.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when a query is sent; {count} is the number of characters of SQL sent and {server} is the connection’s server name.

multi_target_bottom_line.location: Data-change review dialog → summary headline for a multi-connection run: {bottom_line} is the uppercase change summary (e.g. “WE WILL MAKE UPDATE CHANGES.”), {count} the number of connections, {targets} their comma-separated names.

multi_target_confirm_mutation.location: Workbench → multi-target data-change review: status asking the user to confirm the mutation across the selected connections.

multi_target_generating_ai_review.location: Workbench → multi-target data-change review: busy status while the required AI review is generated.

multi_target_manual_unavailable.value: Запуски на нескольких подключениях недоступны в режиме ручной фиксации
multi_target_manual_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the user tries to run a query on several connections while the tab’s transaction mode is Manual commit; multi-connection runs need auto-commit.

multi_target_procedure_unavailable.value: Запуск на нескольких подключениях недоступен в режиме процедуры
multi_target_procedure_unavailable.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: refusal shown when the active editor is in procedure mode.

multi_target_production_refusal.location: Workbench → Status bar: error refusing a multi-connection run because one selected production connection is read-only; {message} is the production read-only explanation, {profile} the name of that connection.

multi_target_query_cancelled.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: final summary shown when cancellation finishes without target failures.

multi_target_query_running.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: busy status while the query runs on the selected connections.

multi_target_review_pending.value: Сначала подтвердите или отмените ожидающую проверку изменения.
multi_target_review_pending.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: refusal shown while another mutation review is pending for the tab.

multi_target_snapshot_read_only.value: Вкладки экспорта SQLLY доступны только для чтения и не могут выполнять запросы.
multi_target_snapshot_read_only.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: refusal shown when the selected tab contains a read-only result snapshot.

multi_target_tenant_refusal_with_profile.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution → tenant safety gate: refusal annotated with the connection that rejected the statement; {message} is the localized tenant refusal and {profile} is the connection name.

mutation_cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown after the user clicks Cancel in the data-change review dialog, confirming the data-changing query was not run.

no_active_connection.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the user runs a query in a tab while no database connection is active; nothing is executed.

no_count_returned.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when the background COUNT query for “Calculate total rows” finished but returned no usable number.

no_valid_connections.value: Не выбрано ни одного корректного подключения
no_valid_connections.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a multi-connection run starts but none of the chosen connections still exist in the saved connection list, so nothing runs.

not_connected.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is clicked but the workbench has no active connection to run the count on.

not_select_only.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: generic failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is used on SQL that is not purely a SELECT and no more specific reason is available.

pick_connection.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a run on multiple connections is started with an empty selection in the connection picker; asks the user to choose at least one connection.

production_read_only.value: Рабочая база (production) доступна только для чтения. Разблокируйте запись (1/5/15 мин) в чипе строки состояния или в палитре команд.
production_read_only.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when data-changing SQL is run on a connection marked Production while writes are locked; explains how to unlock writes for 1, 5 or 15 minutes via the status-bar chip or Command Palette.

query_cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown after the user cancels the running query in the current tab, or when a run ends because it was cancelled.

query_complete.location: Workbench → Status bar: fallback success message shown when a single-connection query finishes but no elapsed time was reported, so the detailed statements/rows/seconds summary cannot be built.

query_failed_title.location: macOS system notification → title: heading of the desktop notification posted when a query fails while the SQLLY window is in the background and system notifications are enabled; the error text is the body.

query_running.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy progress message shown while a single-connection query is executing in the current tab.

result_set_label.location: Results → Result set tabs (multi-connection run): label of the second and later result sets returned by one connection; {name} is the connection name and {number} the result set’s position within that connection’s output.

resume_switch_default_database.location: Workbench → query execution resume prompt: database value substituted when the remembered connection has no explicit database.

resume_switch_prompt.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation prompt shown when the user runs a restored tab while disconnected, asking whether to reconnect to the tab’s remembered connection; {server} is the server name, {database} the database.

review_pending.value: Сначала подтвердите или отмените ожидающую проверку изменения.
review_pending.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the user tries to run another query in a tab whose data-change review dialog is still open; asks them to confirm or cancel that review first.

rollback_bypassed.value: Выполняется без защитной обёртки с откатом (только для этого запуска)
rollback_bypassed.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the “Execute Without Rollback Wrap” command is used on a connection that normally wraps runs in a rolled-back transaction; applies to this one run only.

row_affected_note.location: AI assistant / MCP agent → write proposal record and audit log: singular note saved when an approved agent write runs and exactly one row was changed; {rows} is the affected row count (1).

rows_affected_note.location: AI assistant / MCP agent → write proposal record and audit log: plural note saved when an approved agent write runs and zero or several rows were changed; {rows} is the affected row count.

snapshot_read_only.value: Вкладки экспорта SQLLY являются только для чтения и не могут выполнять запросы
snapshot_read_only.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the user tries to run a query in a tab opened from a saved SQLLY result export, which only displays a frozen snapshot and has no connection to execute on.

summary_many_failures.location: Workbench → Status bar: final summary after a query ran on several connections and more than one failed; {count} is the number of connections, {failures} the number that failed.

summary_many_one_failure.location: Workbench → Status bar: final summary after a query ran on several connections and exactly one of them failed; {count} is the number of connections.

summary_many_success.location: Workbench → Status bar: final success summary after a query ran on several connections and none failed; {count} is the number of connections.

summary_one_failure.location: Workbench → Status bar: final error summary after a multi-connection run that targeted only one connection, which failed.

summary_one_success.location: Workbench → Status bar: final success summary after a multi-connection run that targeted only one connection and succeeded.

summary_row.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: singular segment for rows returned, joined by “·” with other parts (e.g. “1 statement · 1 row · 0.12 s”); {count} is 1.

summary_row_affected.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: singular segment for rows changed by INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, joined by “·” with other parts; {count} is 1.

summary_rows.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: plural segment for the number of rows the query returned, joined by “·” with other parts (e.g. “1 statement · 42 rows · 0.12 s”); {count} is the row count.

summary_rows_affected.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: plural segment for the number of rows changed by INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, joined by “·” with other parts; {count} is the affected row count.

summary_seconds.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: final segment giving the elapsed run time; {seconds} is the time in seconds with two decimals; keep the unit abbreviation very short.

summary_statement.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: singular first segment counting executed statements, e.g. “1 statement · 42 rows · 0.12 s”; {count} is 1.

summary_statements.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: plural first segment counting executed statements, e.g. “3 statements · 128 rows affected · 0.42 s”; {count} is the number of statements.

tab_closed_before_token.value: Вкладка запроса была закрыта до получения токена
tab_closed_before_token.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a query was waiting for a sign-in access token (Microsoft Entra ID or cloud IAM) and its tab was closed before the token arrived, so the run is dropped.

target_cancelled.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): line added when the run on one connection is cancelled; {name} is that connection’s name, shown in square brackets as a prefix.

target_completed.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): line added when the run on one connection finishes successfully; {name} is the connection name in brackets, {milliseconds} its elapsed time in milliseconds.

target_fallback.location: Results → Result set tabs (multi-connection run): label of a connection’s first result set when that connection has no display name; {number} is the connection’s position in the run (1, 2, …).

target_name.location: Results → Result set tabs and Messages tab (multi-connection run): generic noun used in place of a connection’s name when it has none, in later result-set labels and bracketed error lines.

unknown_connection_plural.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): plural note added at the start of the run when several selected connections no longer exist and were skipped; {count} is how many.

unknown_connection_singular.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): singular note added at the start of the run when one selected connection no longer exists and was skipped; {count} is 1.

waiting_for_required_ai_review.value: Ожидание проверки ИИ — это подключение требует её перед выполнением изменений данных.
waiting_for_required_ai_review.location: Workbench → data-change review dialog → Execute action: informational status shown when confirmation is attempted before the required AI review has arrived.

action_alter_script.location: Workbench → Status bar → Fetching object definition: noun phrase “ALTER script” filled into {action_label} of the fetching/opened messages after Script as ALTER on a view, procedure, or function; used mid-sentence.

action_definition.location: Workbench → Status bar → Fetching object definition: lowercase noun “definition” filled into {action_label} of the fetching/opened messages after Edit Definition on a view, procedure, or function; used mid-sentence.

ai_context_pinned.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Pin to AI Context: status-bar message confirming the object was pinned as context for the AI panel; {object} is the schema-qualified object name, e.g. “dbo.Orders”.

azure_linked.value: Добавлена связь с {name} — подключайтесь из меню его строки или из списка серверов
azure_linked.location: Object Explorer → Azure discovered databases: status-bar success message after clicking a discovered Azure database adds it as a saved connection; {name} is the new connection name; tells the user to connect from the row's menu or the server picker.

columns_not_loaded.value: Предупреждение: столбцы не загружены — DDL будет пустым. Сначала разверните узел таблицы, чтобы загрузить столбцы.
columns_not_loaded.location: Object Explorer → Table context menu → Script As → CREATE To → Clipboard: status-bar warning shown when the table's columns are not loaded yet, so the copied CREATE TABLE script would be empty; tells the user to expand the table node first.

columns_warning_sql_comment.value:
-- Предупреждение: столбцы не загружены. Сначала разверните узел таблицы, чтобы загрузить столбцы.
{ddl}
columns_warning_sql_comment.location: Object Explorer → Table context menu → Script As → CREATE To → New Query Window: SQL comment line inserted at the top of the generated script when the table's columns were not loaded; must stay a valid SQL comment starting with two hyphens.

command_copied.location: Object Explorer → Redis key or key folder context menu → Copy Command / Copy SCAN Command: status-bar success message confirming the Redis read or SCAN command was copied to the clipboard.

connect_ai.value: Подключите сервер, чтобы использовать функции ИИ
connect_ai.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → AI actions (Ask AI, Generate SQL, Find Join Path, Pin to AI Context): status-bar hint shown when the object's server has no resolvable connection, asking the user to connect a server to use AI features.

connect_browse_objects.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы просматривать объекты
connect_browse_objects.location: Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Browse Objects: status-bar hint shown when there is no connection to browse with, asking the user to connect to a database first.

connect_dependencies.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы просмотреть зависимости
connect_dependencies.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → View Dependencies / Find Usages: status-bar hint shown when no connection is available, asking the user to connect to a database to inspect dependencies.

connect_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error message shown when expanding the active server in the Object Explorer fails to connect; {name} is the connection name (or a generic “server” fallback) and {error} is the driver's error text.

connect_fetch_definition.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы получить определения
connect_fetch_definition.location: Object Explorer → View/procedure/function context menu → Edit Definition or Script as ALTER: status-bar hint shown when no connection is available, asking the user to connect to a database to fetch definitions.

connect_query_builder.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы составить запрос
connect_query_builder.location: Workbench → Visual query builder command: status-bar hint shown when the query builder is opened with no active connection, asking the user to connect to a database to design a query.

connect_redis_first.location: Object Explorer → Redis key node: status-bar hint shown when opening a Redis key whose server has no resolvable connection, asking the user to connect to the Redis server first.

connect_relationships.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы просмотреть её связи
connect_relationships.location: Workbench → Relationship Graph command: status-bar hint shown when the relationship (ER) diagram is opened with no active connection, asking the user to connect to a database to view its relationships.

connect_script_objects.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы создать скрипты объектов
connect_script_objects.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Script as CREATE: status-bar hint shown when no connection is available, asking the user to connect to a database to script objects.

connect_server_properties.value: Подключитесь к серверу, чтобы просмотреть его свойства
connect_server_properties.location: Workbench → Properties command with nothing selected: status-bar error shown when there is no active connection, asking the user to connect to a server to see its server properties.

connect_terminal.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы открыть её в терминале
connect_terminal.location: Command Palette → Open in Terminal: status-bar hint shown when there is no active connection, asking the user to connect to a database before opening it in the database's command-line client in a terminal.

connected.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown once the active server's database list loads in the Object Explorer, confirming the connection and replacing the “Connecting…” status; {name} is the connection name.

create_copied.value: Скрипт CREATE TABLE скопирован в буфер обмена
create_copied.location: Object Explorer → Table context menu → Script As → CREATE To → Clipboard: status-bar success message confirming the CREATE TABLE script was copied to the clipboard.

create_opened.value: Скрипт CREATE TABLE открыт в новом запросе
create_opened.location: Object Explorer → Table context menu → Script As → CREATE To → New Query Window: status-bar message confirming the CREATE TABLE script was opened in a new query tab.

create_script_opened.value: Скрипт CREATE открыт в новом запросе
create_script_opened.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Script as CREATE: status-bar success message after the CREATE script fetched from the server opens in a new query tab.

credentials_unresolved.location: Command Palette → Open in Terminal: status-bar error shown when the saved credentials for the connection cannot be loaded before launching the terminal; {error} is the underlying reason.

database_search_unavailable.value: Поиск значений в базе данных недоступен
database_search_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer → Database context menu → Search Database for Value: feature name “Database value search” inserted into the browser-preview “not available” status message; it names the unavailable feature.

definition_fetch_failed.location: Object Explorer → Edit Definition / Script as ALTER: status-bar error shown when fetching the view, procedure, or function definition from the server fails; {error} is the server or driver error.

definition_opened.location: Object Explorer → Edit Definition / Script as ALTER: status-bar success message after the fetched definition opens in a new query tab; {action_label} is “definition” or “ALTER script”, {schema}.{name} is the object.

definition_supported_objects.value: Определение доступно только для представлений, процедур и функций
definition_supported_objects.location: Command Palette → Object search → Open Definition action: status-bar hint shown when the chosen result is a server or database, explaining definitions exist only for views, procedures, and functions; the item is revealed instead.

definition_unavailable.location: Object Explorer → Edit Definition / Script as ALTER: status-bar message shown when the server returns no definition text for the object; {schema}.{name} is the view, procedure, or function.

dependencies_select_object.location: Workbench → Object Explorer → View Dependencies or Find Usages: status shown when no database object is selected.

dump_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer → Database context menu → Export Database as SQL: feature name “Exporting a database dump” inserted into the browser-preview “not available” status message.

edit_definition_supported.value: Редактирование определения работает с представлениями, процедурами и функциями
edit_definition_supported.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Edit Definition / Script as ALTER: status-bar hint shown when the selected node is not a view, procedure, or function, explaining which object types the command works on.

export_tables_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer → Database or schema context menu → Export Tables: feature name “Exporting tables to files” inserted into the browser-preview “not available” status message.

fetching_create_script.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Script as CREATE: busy status-bar message shown while the object's CREATE script is fetched from the server; {name} is the object name.

fetching_definition.location: Object Explorer → Edit Definition / Script as ALTER: busy status-bar message shown while the definition is fetched from the server; {action_label} is “definition” or “ALTER script”, {schema}.{name} is the object.

filter_select_object.value: Выберите таблицу или представление для фильтрации
filter_select_object.location: Object Explorer → Table or view context menu → Filter Data: status-bar hint shown when no table or view node is selected, asking the user to select a table or view to filter.

generated_query_inserted.location: Visual query builder → Insert into editor: status-bar message confirming the generated SQL was inserted into the active query editor (or a new tab) and the builder closed.

hidden_schemas_save_first.location: Explorer → Schema context menu → Hide Schema / Show Hidden Schemas → Status bar: error shown when the connection is not a saved connection, so hidden schemas cannot be remembered with it.

hidden_schemas_shown.location: Explorer → Database context menu → Show Hidden Schemas → Status bar: confirmation after the hidden schemas of a database are shown in the explorer again. {count} is how many schemas, {database} the database name.

identifier_inserted.location: Query editor → Drag and drop from the Object Explorer: status-bar message confirming the dragged object or column name was inserted into the editor as a quoted identifier.

import_clipboard_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer → Database context menu → Import from Clipboard: feature name “Importing from the clipboard” inserted into the browser-preview “not available” status message.

invocation_copied.location: Object Explorer → Procedure or function context menu → Copy EXEC Script / Copy Invocation: status-bar success message confirming the call script was copied; {schema}.{name} is the routine.

invocation_select_routine.value: Выберите процедуру или функцию для вызова
invocation_select_routine.location: Object Explorer → Procedure or function context menu → Run / Copy EXEC Script: status-bar hint shown when no procedure or function node is selected, asking the user to select one to invoke.

kind_function.location: Object Explorer → View Dependencies / Find Usages → Dependencies dialog title: object-type word “Function” filled into {kind} of the title when the inspected object is a function.

kind_procedure.location: Object Explorer → View Dependencies / Find Usages → Dependencies dialog title: object-type word “Procedure” filled into {kind} of the title when the inspected object is a stored procedure.

kind_table.location: Object Explorer → View Dependencies / Find Usages → Dependencies dialog title: object-type word “Table” filled into {kind} of the title when the inspected object is a table (the default for other node types).

kind_view.location: Object Explorer → View Dependencies / Find Usages → Dependencies dialog title: object-type word “View” filled into {kind} of the title when the inspected object is a view.

name_copied.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Copy → Copy Name: status-bar success message confirming the object's plain name was copied to the clipboard.

new_query.location: Object Explorer → Server context menu → New Query: status-bar message confirming a new empty query tab was opened on the node's server when no specific database applies.

new_query_database.location: Object Explorer → Database context menu → New Query: status-bar message confirming a new empty query tab was opened bound to that database; {database} is the database name.

new_query_selected_server.value: Открыт новый запрос на выбранном сервере
new_query_selected_server.location: Object Explorer → Server context menu → Open in New Query: status-bar message confirming a fresh query tab was opened targeting the selected server.

no_profile_node.value: Профиль подключения для этого узла отсутствует
no_profile_node.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Properties: status-bar error shown when the clicked node has no saved connection behind it, so its properties dialog cannot open.

object_not_loaded.location: Relationship Graph → Reveal in Explorer: status-bar message shown when the chosen table is not yet loaded in the Object Explorer tree and cannot be revealed; {name} is the table name.

object_revealed.location: Relationship Graph → Reveal in Explorer: status-bar message confirming the chosen table was revealed and selected in the Object Explorer; {name} is the table name.

open_in_terminal_feature.location: Object Explorer → Connection context menu → Open in Terminal on a relay connection: command name inserted as {feature} into the warning saying it needs a direct connection.

properties_opened.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Properties: status-bar message confirming the object properties dialog opened.

properties_unavailable_node.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Properties: status-bar error shown when the clicked node lacks the schema, name, or database needed to open a properties dialog.

properties_unavailable_type.value: Свойства недоступны для этого типа узла
properties_unavailable_type.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Properties: status-bar error shown when the clicked node's type (for example a folder) has no properties dialog.

qualified_name_copied.value: Полное имя скопировано в буфер обмена
qualified_name_copied.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Copy → Copy Qualified Name: status-bar success message confirming the bracket-quoted schema-qualified name was copied to the clipboard.

query_connection_switched.value: Подключение запроса переключено на выбранный сервер
query_connection_switched.location: Object Explorer → Server context menu → Connect to Current Query: status-bar success message confirming the active query tab now uses the selected server and database.

quick_open_new_query_selected_server.value: Открыт новый запрос на выбранном сервере
quick_open_new_query_selected_server.location: Workbench → Quick Open → server or database result: status shown after a blank query tab opens on the selected target.

quick_open_not_loaded.value: {name} больше не загружен — обновите обозреватель объектов
quick_open_not_loaded.location: Command Palette → Object search → Reveal in Explorer action: status-bar message shown when the chosen object is no longer loaded in the Object Explorer; {name} is the object; asks the user to refresh the explorer.

quick_open_sql_opened_new_tab.location: Workbench → Quick Open → table or view result: status shown after the generated SELECT opens in a new query tab.

refreshed.location: Workbench → Refresh Object Explorer command: status-bar success message confirming the connection list, the active server's schema tree, and its IntelliSense catalog were reloaded.

relationships_select_table.value: Выберите таблицу, чтобы выделить её на диаграмме связей
relationships_select_table.location: Object Explorer → Table context menu → Focus in relationships diagram: status-bar hint shown when no table node is selected, asking the user to select a table to focus in the relationships diagram.

run_sql_file_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer → Database context menu → Run SQL File: feature name “Running SQL files” inserted into the browser-preview “not available” status message.

save_data_select_opened.value: Сохранить данные как: открыт запрос SELECT. Выполните его, затем используйте Результаты > Экспорт.
save_data_select_opened.location: Browser preview → Object Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As → CSV/Excel: status-bar message saying a SELECT query was opened instead; tells the user to execute it, then use Results → Export.

schema_hidden.value: Схема {schema} скрыта в {database}. Щёлкните базу данных правой кнопкой мыши и выберите «Показать скрытые схемы», чтобы вернуть её.
schema_hidden.location: Explorer → Schema context menu → Hide Schema → Status bar: confirmation after a schema is hidden from the explorer for this connection, telling the user how to bring it back. {schema} is the schema name, {database} the database name.

schema_refreshed_status.location: Workbench → Object Explorer → Refresh Schema action: success status after the selected server schema refresh starts.

script_opened_new_query.location: Object Properties dialog → Script button: status-bar message confirming the generated script opened in a new query tab while the properties dialog stays open.

select_object.location: Object Explorer → Edit Definition / Script as ALTER: status-bar hint shown when the command runs without an object node selected, asking the user to select an object first.

select_query_opened.location: Object Explorer → Double-click on a table or view: status-bar message confirming a SELECT TOP 1000 query was opened in a new tab against that object's server and database.

snapshot_open_failed.location: Result Snapshots dialog → Open: status-bar error shown when the chosen saved result snapshot cannot be read; {error} is the parse error.

snapshot_select_database.value: Щелкните правой кнопкой мыши по базе данных, чтобы создать снимок её схемы
snapshot_select_database.location: Object Explorer → Database context menu → Save Schema Snapshot / Schema History: status-bar hint shown when the node is not tied to a database, asking the user to right-click a database to snapshot its schema.

sql_opened_new_tab.location: Object Explorer → Context menu scripting (e.g. Select Top 1000, Script As): status-bar message confirming the generated SQL opened in a new query tab on the node's server and database.

terminal_launch_failed.location: Command Palette → Open in Terminal: status-bar error shown when preparing the database command-line client in a terminal fails; {error} is the underlying reason.

terminal_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Command Palette → Open in Terminal: feature name “Open in Terminal” inserted into the browser-preview “not available” status message.

rejected.value: sqlly.app отклонил {kind}; повторная отправка не выполняется: {reason}
rejected.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: status-bar error that sqlly.app refused the report permanently (for example it was too large), so it was discarded and will not be retried; {kind} is “Feedback” or “IntelliSense feedback”, {reason} the server's explanation.

saved_later.value: Мы сохранили {kind} на этом компьютере и отправим автоматически через {when} ({reason}).
saved_later.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: status-bar warning that the report was saved on this computer and will be sent automatically after a set time because sqlly.app asked the app to wait; {kind} is “Feedback” or “IntelliSense feedback”, {when} the local date and time it will be sent after (e.g. 2026-10-31 14:05), {reason} which limit was hit.

browser_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Help menu → Send Feedback: feature name “Send Feedback” inserted into the browser-preview “not available” status message, since the browser build cannot capture or upload feedback.

capturing_screenshot.location: Help menu → Send Feedback: busy status-bar message shown briefly while SQLLY screenshots the window before opening the feedback dialog.

kind_general.location: Workbench → Status bar → Feedback upload messages: word “Feedback” filled into {kind} of the sent/saved/failed messages for a general Send Feedback report; sentence subject.

kind_intellisense.location: Workbench → Status bar → Feedback upload messages: phrase “IntelliSense feedback” filled into {kind} of the sent/saved/failed messages for an IntelliSense completion report; sentence subject.

prepare_failed.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: status-bar error shown when the report could not be prepared (settings snapshot, screenshot encoding, or saving); {kind} is the feedback type and {reason} the error.

save_failed.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: status-bar error shown when the report was dropped and could not be saved for upload; {kind} is “Feedback” or “IntelliSense feedback”.

saved_retry.value: {kind} сохранён на этом компьютере — отправка не удалась ({reason}); повторная попытка каждые {interval}.
saved_retry.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: status-bar warning that the report was saved on this computer but the upload failed; {kind} is the feedback type, {reason} the upload error, {interval} the retry period, e.g. “5 minutes”.

saved_sending.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: status-bar message shown when the background uploader already picked up the saved report and is sending it; {kind} is the feedback type.

sending.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: busy status-bar message shown while the submitted feedback report is saved and uploaded.

sent.location: Send Feedback → after submitting: status-bar success message thanking the user once the report was uploaded; {kind} is “Feedback” or “IntelliSense feedback”.

window_open_failed.location: Help menu → Send Feedback: status-bar error shown when the separate Send Feedback window could not be opened after the screenshot was taken.

window_opened.location: Help menu → Send Feedback: status-bar message confirming the Send Feedback dialog opened in its own new window with the screenshot attached.

certificate_write_failed.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import: status-bar error shown when a certificate or private-key file from the Redis Insight export cannot be written; {path} is the PEM file path, {error} the system error.

collect_rows_query_failed.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As (CSV, Excel, SQLLY export): status-bar error shown when the server reports an error while the table rows are read for the file; {error} is the server message.

collect_script_query_failed.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Script As / Save Data As (INSERT, MERGE, temp table script): status-bar error shown when the server reports an error while reading the rows to script; {error} is the server message.

connection_export_write_failed.location: File menu → Export connections / Export credentials: status-bar error shown when the chosen connection export file cannot be created, written or moved into place; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

connections_exported_plural.location: File menu → Export connections: status-bar success message after several connections were written to the export file without passwords; plural form, {count} is the number of connections, {path} the file path.

connections_exported_plural_missing.value: Экспортировано {count} подключений без паролей в {path}. Без сохранённого пароля: {missing}.
connections_exported_plural_missing.location: File menu → Export connections: status-bar success message after several connections were exported without passwords, noting how many had no saved password; plural form, {count} connections, {path} file path, {missing} count without a password.

connections_exported_singular.location: File menu → Export connections: status-bar success message after exactly one connection was written to the export file without passwords; singular form, {count} is 1, {path} is the file path.

connections_exported_singular_missing.value: Экспортировано {count} подключение без паролей в {path}. Без сохранённого пароля: {missing}.
connections_exported_singular_missing.location: File menu → Export connections: status-bar success message after one connection was exported without passwords, noting it had no saved password; singular form, {count} is 1, {path} the file path, {missing} the count without a password.

credentials_exported_plural.value: Экспортировано {count} подключений с паролями в открытом виде в {path}. Держите этот файл в тайне.
credentials_exported_plural.location: File menu → Export credentials: status-bar success message after several connections were written with passwords in clear text, warning to keep the file private; plural form, {count} connections, {path} file path.

credentials_exported_plural_missing.value: Экспортировано {count} подключений с паролями в открытом виде в {path}. Держите этот файл в тайне. Без сохранённого пароля: {missing}.
credentials_exported_plural_missing.location: File menu → Export credentials: status-bar success message after several connections were exported with clear-text passwords, also noting how many had no saved password; plural, {count} connections, {path} file path, {missing} count without a password.

credentials_exported_singular.value: Экспортировано {count} подключение с паролями в открытом виде в {path}. Держите этот файл в тайне.
credentials_exported_singular.location: File menu → Export credentials: status-bar success message after one connection was written with its password in clear text, warning to keep the file private; singular form, {count} is 1, {path} is the file path.

credentials_exported_singular_missing.value: Экспортировано {count} подключение с паролями в открытом виде в {path}. Держите этот файл в тайне. Без сохранённого пароля: {missing}.
credentials_exported_singular_missing.location: File menu → Export credentials: status-bar success message after one connection was exported with clear-text passwords but had no saved password; singular form, {count} is 1, {path} the file path, {missing} the count without a password.

disk_close_button.location: Query editor → File deleted on disk alert: second button that closes the query tab whose backing file was deleted outside SQLLY.

disk_deleted_detail.value: Оставьте текст в редакторе как несохранённую вкладку или закройте её.
disk_deleted_detail.location: Query editor → File deleted on disk alert: explanatory text under the title, shown when the open tab’s file was deleted outside SQLLY, explaining the Keep and Close choices.

disk_deleted_message.value: «{name}» был удалён или перемещён на диске.
disk_deleted_message.location: SQLLY → Files: text shown as ““{name}” was deleted or moved on disk.”.

disk_keep_button.location: Query editor → File changed or deleted on disk alert: button that keeps the current editor text and dismisses the alert (second button when the file changed, first button when it was deleted).

disk_modified_detail_clean.value: Перезагрузите, чтобы заменить текст в редакторе содержимым файла, или оставьте свою версию.
disk_modified_detail_clean.location: Query editor → File changed on disk alert: explanatory text shown when the open tab’s file was modified outside SQLLY and the tab has no unsaved edits, explaining Reload and Keep.

disk_modified_detail_dirty.value: Перезагрузите, чтобы заменить текст в редакторе содержимым файла, или оставьте свою версию. Несохранённые изменения будут потеряны.
disk_modified_detail_dirty.location: Query editor → File changed on disk alert: explanatory text shown when the open tab’s file was modified outside SQLLY while the tab has unsaved edits, warning Reload would discard them.

disk_modified_message.location: Query editor → File changed on disk alert: alert title shown when the active tab’s SQL file was modified by another program; {name} is the query tab name.

disk_reload_button.location: Query editor → File changed on disk alert: first button that replaces the editor text with the file’s new contents from disk.

drop_opened_plural.location: Main window → Drag and drop files: status-bar success message after several dropped SQL or database files were opened; plural form, {count} is the number of files opened.

drop_opened_singular.location: Main window → Drag and drop files: status-bar success message after exactly one dropped SQL or database file was opened; singular form, {count} is 1.

drop_unsupported.value: Сюда можно перетащить только файлы .sql и SQLite (.sqlite, .db, .sqlite3)
drop_unsupported.location: Main window → Drag and drop files: status-bar notice shown when every file dropped onto the window was ignored because none is a .sql or SQLite database file.

dropped_open_failed.location: Workbench → drag and drop: error shown when a dropped SQL file cannot be read; {path} is the dropped file path and {error} is the filesystem error.

export_cancelled.location: Results → Export to file → Background task: status-bar notice shown when the user cancels a running results export before it finished writing the file.

export_connections_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Export connections: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when the user tries to export connections in the web version.

export_credentials_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Export credentials: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when the user tries to export connections with passwords in the web version.

export_extension_required.location: File menu → Open SQLLY Export: status-bar error shown when the file picked in the open panel does not have the .sqllyexport extension.

export_inspect_failed.location: File menu → Open SQLLY Export: status-bar error shown when the size and details of the chosen .sqllyexport file cannot be checked; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

export_preparing.value: Подготовка экспорта — чтение {count} строк с диска…
export_preparing.location: Results → Save Results (non-streamed formats): progress caption shown over the results while large spilled rows are read back from disk before writing; {count} is the number of rows being read.

export_read_failed.location: File menu → Open SQLLY Export: status-bar error shown when the chosen .sqllyexport file cannot be read as text; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

export_results_browser_unavailable.value: Экспорт результатов в файл недоступен (копирование ячеек в буфер обмена по-прежнему работает)
export_results_browser_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Save Results: status-bar error shown in the web version, where results cannot be saved to a file but cells can still be copied to the clipboard.

export_saved_notification_title.location: macOS/system notification → Export finished: title of the operating-system notification raised when a results, table data or schema documentation export finishes while SQLLY is in the background.

export_saved_status.location: Results → Export to file: status-bar and notification-center success message after a streamed export finishes; {label} is the export task label (format and file name), {count} the number of rows written.

export_size_limit.location: File menu → Open SQLLY Export: status-bar error shown when the chosen .sqllyexport file is larger than the 64 MiB limit and is not opened.

export_task_label.location: Background tasks list → Results export: label of a running results export task; {format} is the export format name (e.g. CSV), {name} the destination file name; the arrow means “written to”.

git_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Command palette → Project Folder: Git Changes: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when Git integration is requested in the web version.

import_cancel_button.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: footer button that closes the preview without importing any connection.

import_confirm_button.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: primary footer button that adds the listed connections to SQLLY’s saved connections.

import_connections_empty.value: В выбранном файле не найдено подключений
import_connections_empty.location: File menu → Import connections: status-bar notice shown when the chosen SQLLY connection file was read successfully but contains no connections to import.

import_connections_prompt.location: File menu → Import connections → System open panel: confirm-button label (and panel prompt) of the native file chooser used to pick a SQLLY connection file; imperative command.

import_connections_read_failed.location: File menu → Import connections: status-bar error shown when the SQLLY connection file chosen in the open panel cannot be read; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

import_connections_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Import connections: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when importing a SQLLY connection file in the web version.

import_groups_read_failed.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → TablePlus import: status-bar error shown when the ConnectionGroups.plist next to the chosen TablePlus file exists but cannot be read; {path} is that file, {error} the system error.

import_no_database.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: placeholder used in a connection row’s database position when the imported connection names no database; short, parenthesized.

import_notes.value: Пароли не импортируются; вам будет предложено ввести их при первом подключении.
import_notes.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: note under the connection list explaining that passwords are not imported and will be asked for on first connect (no SSH tunnels, no saved passwords in source).

import_notes_ignored.value: Пароли не импортируются; вам будет предложено ввести их при первом подключении. Сохранённые пароли в исходном файле игнорируются намеренно.
import_notes_ignored.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: note under the list shown for Navicat, TablePlus, Azure Data Studio / VS Code, DbGate or pg_service.conf files that contained saved passwords, saying passwords are not imported and those saved ones are deliberately ignored.

import_notes_ssh.value: Пароли не импортируются; вам будет предложено ввести их при первом подключении. Пароли для SSH-туннеля не импортируются.
import_notes_ssh.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: note under the list shown when some connections use an SSH tunnel, saying neither database nor SSH tunnel passwords are imported.

import_notes_ssh_ignored.value: Пароли не импортируются; вам будет предложено ввести их при первом подключении. Пароли для SSH-туннеля не импортируются. Сохранённые пароли в исходном файле игнорируются намеренно.
import_notes_ssh_ignored.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: note shown when connections use SSH tunnels and the Navicat, TablePlus, Azure Data Studio / VS Code, DbGate or pg_service.conf source held saved passwords, saying no passwords are imported and saved ones are ignored on purpose.

import_preview_row.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: one row per connection that will be imported; {name} connection name, {engine} database engine, {server}:{port}/{database} the target, {project} an optional “ (group)” suffix.

import_preview_skipped.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: dimmed row for a connection that will not be imported; {name} is the connection name, {reason} why it is skipped (e.g. already saved, unsupported engine).

import_tools_plural.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools: status-bar success message after confirming the preview when zero or several connections were imported; {imported} is the number imported, {skipped} the number skipped.

import_tools_prompt.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → System open panel: confirm-button label (and panel prompt) of the native file chooser used to pick a DataGrip, DBeaver, TablePlus, Navicat, Redis Insight, pgAdmin, Azure Data Studio / VS Code, DbGate or PostgreSQL service file.

import_tools_read_failed.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools: status-bar error shown when the other tool’s connection file chosen in the open panel cannot be read; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

import_tools_singular.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools: status-bar success message after confirming the preview when exactly one connection was imported; {imported} is 1, {skipped} the number of connections skipped.

import_tools_supported.value: Поддерживаются: dataSources.xml (DataGrip), data-sources.json (DBeaver), Connections.plist или экспорт .tableplusconnection (TablePlus), экспорт .ncx (Navicat), servers.json (pgAdmin), settings.json (Azure Data Studio или VS Code), файл .env (DbGate) и pg_service.conf (PostgreSQL).
import_tools_supported.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: dimmed intro text above the connection list naming the supported source files of each other tool; keep product and file names unchanged.

import_tools_title.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Preview dialog: dialog title of the preview that lists connections found in another tool’s file before they are imported.

tool_export_done_singular.value: Экспортировано {count} подключение для {tool} без паролей в {path}.
tool_export_done_singular.location: File menu → Export for Other Tools: status-bar success message after exactly one connection was saved in another tool's format; {count} is 1, {tool} the product name (untranslated), {path} the file path.

tool_export_done_plural.value: Экспортировано {count} подключений для {tool} без паролей в {path}.
tool_export_done_plural.location: File menu → Export for Other Tools: status-bar success message after zero or several connections were saved in another tool's format; {count} is the number of connections, {tool} the product name (untranslated), {path} the file path.

tool_export_done_singular_skipped.value: Экспортировано {count} подключение для {tool} без паролей в {path}; пропущено: {skipped} (этот инструмент не может их хранить).
tool_export_done_singular_skipped.location: File menu → Export for Other Tools: status-bar success message when one connection was saved in another tool's format and some picked connections were left out because that tool cannot hold them; {count} is 1, {tool} the product name (untranslated), {path} the file path, {skipped} the number left out.

tool_export_done_plural_skipped.value: Экспортировано {count} подключений для {tool} без паролей в {path}; пропущено: {skipped} (этот инструмент не может их хранить).
tool_export_done_plural_skipped.location: File menu → Export for Other Tools: status-bar success message when several connections were saved in another tool's format and some picked connections were left out because that tool cannot hold them; {count} is the number saved, {tool} the product name (untranslated), {path} the file path, {skipped} the number left out.

tool_export_nothing.value: Нет сохранённых подключений, которые {tool} может открыть.
tool_export_nothing.location: File menu → Export for Other Tools: status-bar note shown instead of the picker when no saved connection uses an engine the chosen tool can open; {tool} is the product name (untranslated).

tool_export_unavailable.value: Экспорт подключений для других инструментов недоступен
tool_export_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Export for Other Tools: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when the user tries to save connections for another database tool in the web version.

import_tools_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Import From Other Tools: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when importing from DataGrip, DBeaver and similar tools in the web version.

import_tools_unrecognized.value: Файл подключений не распознан. Поддерживаются: dataSources.xml (DataGrip), data-sources.json (DBeaver), Connections.plist или незащищённый экспорт .tableplusconnection (TablePlus), экспорты .ncx (Navicat), экспорты баз данных Redis Insight, servers.json (pgAdmin), settings.json (Azure Data Studio или VS Code), файлы .env с подключениями (DbGate) и pg_service.conf (PostgreSQL). Защищённые паролем экспорты TablePlus прочитать нельзя — экспортируйте заново без пароля к файлу.
import_tools_unrecognized.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools: status-bar error shown when the chosen file is not a recognized connection file, listing supported formats per tool and explaining that password-protected TablePlus exports cannot be read.

library_choose_folder.location: Sidebar → SQL Library → Change root folder → System open panel: confirm-button label (and prompt) of the native folder chooser used to pick the SQL Library root folder; imperative.

library_connection_missing.value: Файл библиотеки указывает на подключение «{name}», которого нет среди сохранённых
library_connection_missing.location: Sidebar → SQL Library → Open file: status-bar notice shown when an opened library file’s header names a connection that is not saved in SQLLY, so the tab is not connected; {name} is that connection name.

library_open_failed.location: Sidebar → SQL Library: status-bar error shown when a SQL file clicked in the library list cannot be read from disk; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

library_save_failed.location: File menu → Save to Library: status-bar error shown when the active query tab cannot be written into the SQL Library folder; {error} is the system error.

library_save_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Save to Library: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when saving a query to the SQL Library in the web version.

library_saved.location: File menu → Save to Library: status-bar success message after the active query tab was saved as a new file in the SQL Library folder; {path} is the new file path.

no_connections_to_export.location: File menu → Export connections / Export credentials: status-bar notice shown instead of the picker when there are no saved connections or logins to export.

no_results_to_export.location: Results → Save Results / Export: status-bar notice shown when an export or save of results is requested but the active tab has no result set.

notebook_export_failed.location: Notebook tab → Export as Markdown: status-bar error shown when the chosen Markdown file cannot be written; {error} is the system error.

notebook_exported.value: Экспортировано {count} ячеек, предварительный просмотр результатов ограничен 50 строками
notebook_exported.location: Notebook tab → Export as Markdown: status-bar success message after the notebook was written as Markdown; {count} is the number of cells, and each result table preview was limited to 50 rows.

notebook_exported_ipynb.value: Экспортировано {count} ячеек в виде Jupyter notebook в {path}
notebook_exported_ipynb.location: SQL Editor → Notebook → Export Jupyter: status-bar success message after the notebook was saved as a Jupyter .ipynb file; {count} is the number of cells, {path} the file written.

notebook_open_failed.location: File menu → Open Notebook: status-bar error shown when the chosen notebook file cannot be read from disk; {error} is the system error.

notebook_save_failed.location: Workbench → Save Notebook or Save Notebook As: error shown when the notebook file cannot be written; {error} is the filesystem error.

notebook_saved_to_path.location: Workbench → Save Notebook or Save Notebook As: success status showing the written notebook path in {path}.

open_disk_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Open SQL File: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when opening a SQL file from disk in the web version.

open_export_prompt.location: File menu → Open SQLLY Export → System open panel: confirm-button label (and prompt) of the native file chooser used to pick a .sqllyexport results snapshot; imperative.

open_export_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Open SQLLY Export: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when opening a .sqllyexport file in the web version.

open_failed.location: Open Project File picker → Status bar error: status-bar error shown when the SQL file chosen in the project-file picker cannot be read from disk; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

open_folder_prompt.location: File menu → Open Folder → System open panel: confirm-button label (and prompt) of the native folder chooser that sets the project folder for the project-file picker; imperative.

open_folder_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Open Folder: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when opening a project folder in the web version.

open_notebook_prompt.location: File menu → Open Notebook → System open panel: confirm-button label (and prompt) of the native file chooser used to pick a SQLLY notebook file; imperative.

open_project_first.value: Сначала откройте папку проекта (Файл › Открыть папку…)
open_project_first.location: Command palette → Project Folder: Git Changes: status-bar notice shown when no project folder is open yet, telling the user to use File › Open Folder… first; keep the menu path matching the translated menu.

open_sql_prompt.location: File menu → Open SQL File → System open panel: confirm-button label (and prompt) of the native file chooser used to open a .sql file into a new query tab; imperative.

readonly_export_context.location: Results panel → Snapshot banner: banner text above the grid when a .sqllyexport file is opened as a read-only results snapshot; {path} is the export file path, separated by a middle dot.

readonly_export_opened.value: Открыт экспорт SQLLY только для чтения: {title}
readonly_export_opened.location: File menu → Open SQLLY Export: status-bar success message after a .sqllyexport file opened in a new read-only tab; {title} is the tab title taken from the file name.

recent_file_missing.value: {path} больше не существует — удалён из последних файлов
recent_file_missing.location: Tab bar context menu → Recent Files: status-bar warning shown when a chosen recent file no longer exists and was dropped from the list; {path} is the missing file path.

redis_certificate_directory_failed.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import: status-bar error shown when the folder for the export’s certificates and keys cannot be created; {path} is the folder, {error} the system error.

redis_import_failed.value: Не удалось импортировать экспорт Redis Insight: {error}
redis_import_failed.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import: status-bar error shown when the converted Redis Insight connections cannot be saved to SQLLY; {error} is the reason.

redis_import_prepare_failed.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import: status-bar error shown when the Redis Insight connections cannot be converted for import, an internal preparation failure; {error} is the reason.

redis_import_skipped.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import: sentence appended to the import result for each connection left out; {name} is the Redis Insight connection name, {reason} why it was skipped.

redis_import_summary.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import: status-bar result assembled from parts when no certificates were saved; {summary} is the import summary, {skipped} the skipped-connection sentences, {notes} extra notes.

redis_import_summary_certificates.location: File menu → Import From Other Tools → Redis Insight import: status-bar result when TLS certificates/keys were saved; {summary} import summary, {certificates} folder they were saved to, {skipped} skipped sentences, {notes} extra notes.

reload_failed.location: Query editor → File changed on disk alert → Reload: status-bar error shown when the changed SQL file cannot be read back into the tab; {error} is the system error.

result_save_failed.location: Workbench → Save Results export: error shown when the selected result file cannot be written; {error} is the filesystem or exporter error.

results_saved.location: File menu → Save Results: status-bar and notification-center success message after all result rows were written; {format} is the export format name (e.g. JSON), {path} the saved file path.

results_saved_truncated.value: Сохранено {format} в {path} (первые {count} строк; результат был больше)
results_saved_truncated.location: File menu → Save Results: status-bar warning after saving when the result exceeded the row cap and only the first rows were written; {format} format name, {path} file path, {count} the row cap.

save_browser_unavailable.value: Сохранение в файл недоступно (текст вашего запроса остаётся в сессии браузера)
save_browser_unavailable.location: Browser preview → File menu → Save SQL: status-bar error shown in the web version, where the query cannot be saved to a file but stays in the browser session.

save_data_exporting.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As (CSV, Excel, SQLLY export): busy status-bar message shown while the table rows are read and written; {identifier} is the qualified table name.

save_data_no_connection.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As (CSV, Excel, SQLLY export): status-bar error shown when no connection is active, so the table data cannot be read.

save_data_query_failed.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As (CSV, Excel, SQLLY export): status-bar error shown when the SELECT reading the table cannot be started; {error} is the server or connection message.

save_data_saved.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As: status-bar and notification-center success message after all table rows were saved; {rows} rows written, {identifier} qualified table name, {path} file path.

save_data_saved_truncated.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As: success message when the table hit the row cap, so only the first rows were saved; {rows} rows written, {identifier} table, {path} file, {count} the cap (10,000).

save_data_write_failed.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As (CSV, Excel, SQLLY export): status-bar error shown when the read table data cannot be written to the chosen file; {path} is the file path, {error} the system error.

save_failed.location: File menu → Save SQL: status-bar error shown when the query editor text cannot be written to its .sql file; {error} is the system error.

saved_to_path.location: File menu → Save SQL: status-bar success message after the query editor text was written to its .sql file (existing file or newly chosen path); {path} is the file path.

schema_docs_fallback_title.location: Command palette → Document Schema (Markdown): fallback heading used at the top of the generated schema documentation when no connection name is available; noun.

schema_docs_no_model.value: Модель схемы ещё не загружена — подключитесь и дождитесь загрузки модели данных
schema_docs_no_model.location: Command palette → Document Schema (Markdown): status-bar notice shown when no schema model has been loaded yet, asking the user to connect and wait for it to load.

schema_docs_save_failed.location: Command palette → Document Schema (Markdown): status-bar error shown when the generated schema documentation file(s) cannot be written; {error} is the system error.

schema_docs_saved_multiple.location: Command palette → Document Schema (Markdown): success message when a large schema was split into an index plus one file per schema; {path} is the main file path, {count} the number of files written.

schema_docs_saved_single.location: Command palette → Document Schema (Markdown): status-bar and notification-center success message after the schema documentation was written as a single Markdown file; {path} is the file path.

schema_docs_unavailable.value: Сохранение документации схемы в файл недоступно
schema_docs_unavailable.location: Browser preview → Command palette → Document Schema (Markdown): feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” status-bar error when saving schema documentation in the web version.

script_generated.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Script As / Save Data As: status-bar success message after the data script opened in a new query tab; {kind} is “INSERT”, “MERGE” or the translated “temp table”.

script_generating.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Script As / Save Data As: busy status-bar message while the table rows are read to build a script; {kind} is INSERT, MERGE or “temp table”, {table} the qualified table name.

script_kind_temp_table.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Save Data As → temp table script: lowercase noun inserted as {kind} into the “Generating … script” and “… script generated” status-bar messages.

script_no_connection.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Script As / Save Data As (INSERT, MERGE, temp table): status-bar error shown when no connection is active, so the script cannot be generated.

script_query_failed.location: Database Explorer → Table context menu → Script As / Save Data As (INSERT, MERGE, temp table): status-bar error shown when the SELECT reading the rows cannot be started; {error} is the server message.

notebook_reload_failed.location: Notebook → conflict notice → Reload from disk: status-bar error shown when the changed notebook file cannot be read again; {error} is the system error.

notebook_browser_save_failed.location: Browser version → Save Notebook: error shown when the notebook cannot be written to the file chosen in the browser; {error} is the browser's error.

connect_first.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы проследить внешние ключи.
connect_first.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Open Referenced Row: status-bar notice shown when the command is used but no connection is active; short imperative.

not_foreign_key.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Open Referenced Row: status-bar notice shown when the clicked column is not part of a foreign key; {column} is the column name.

null_value.value: Невозможно перейти по NULL-значению внешнего ключа.
null_value.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Open Referenced Row: status-bar notice shown when the clicked foreign-key cell is NULL, so there is no referenced row to open; keep “NULL” as the SQL keyword.

opened.location: Results → Grid → Cell context menu → Open Referenced Row: status-bar message after a new query tab opened and ran a SELECT for the referenced parent row; {schema} and {table} name the referenced table.

diff_header.value:
-- Версия сравнивается с текущим буфером.
-- Строки, начинающиеся с -, есть только в версии; с + — только в текущем буфере.
diff_header.location: Query editor → History panel → Compare with current: first line of the read-only diff text opened in a new tab, introducing the line-by-line differences between the chosen saved version and the current editor text.

diff_tab_title.location: Query editor → History panel → Compare with current: name of the new query tab that opens holding the diff between a saved version and the current editor text; short tab label.

diff_truncated.location: Query editor → History panel → Compare with current: note appended at the end of the diff tab when the comparison exceeded the line limit and the remaining differences were cut off.

disabled.value: История версий запросов отключена (Настройки > Редактор > История запросов)
disabled.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the user tries to open a query tab's History panel while query version history is turned off in Settings.

results_unavailable_sql_restored.value: Сохранённые результаты для этой версии не удалось загрузить; восстановлен только SQL.
results_unavailable_sql_restored.location: Workbench → Status bar: warning shown after restoring a saved query version whose stored results could not be loaded; the version's SQL was restored into the editor but its results were not.

toggle_disabled.location: Workbench → Toggle Query History action: status shown when query history is disabled in preferences.

version_not_found.value: Эта версия больше не в истории
version_not_found.location: Workbench → Status bar: warning shown when comparing a History panel version with the current editor text fails because that saved version no longer exists.

version_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when restoring a version from the History panel fails because the version was deleted or evicted between the click and the restore.

viewing_results_banner.value: Просмотр результатов от {timestamp} — выполните запрос для обновления
viewing_results_banner.location: Results → Historical results banner: strip above the read-only results restored with an older query version; {timestamp} is when that version was saved; tells the user to run the query to get fresh results.

connect.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы выполнить обслуживание
connect.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a Maintenance action (VACUUM, ANALYZE, REINDEX and similar) is chosen in the Object Explorer context menu but no connection can be resolved; asks the user to connect first.

list_failed.value: Не удалось получить список таблиц для {operation}: {error}
list_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a database-wide Maintenance action could not read the list of tables it runs per table; {operation} is the maintenance operation name, {error} the server error.

listing_tables.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy message while a database-wide Maintenance action first reads the table list to build one statement per table; {operation} is the maintenance operation name (for example ANALYZE TABLE).

script_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the SQL for an Object Explorer Maintenance action could not be generated; {operation} is the maintenance operation name, {error} the reason.

scripted.value: Скрипт {operation} открыт в новой вкладке — проверьте перед выполнением
scripted.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message after a Maintenance action’s Script form opens its statement in a new query tab for review (nothing runs yet); {operation} is the maintenance operation name.

unsupported.value: Эта операция обслуживания недоступна для этой СУБД
unsupported.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the chosen Object Explorer Maintenance action has no equivalent statement for this database engine at the selected object level (database, table, or index).

production_rejected.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a query proposed by an external AI agent through the MCP server targeted a production connection and was automatically rejected; MCP never drives production connections.

query_opened.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message after a read-only query proposed by an external AI agent through the MCP server is opened in a new query tab for the user to review and run.

columns_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when Object Explorer → Generate Model could not read a table’s or view’s columns; {object} is the schema-qualified object name, {error} the reason.

connect.value: Подключитесь к базе данных, чтобы создать модель
connect.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when Object Explorer → Generate Model is used but no connection can be resolved for the selected node; asks the user to connect first.

copied.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message after Object Explorer → Generate Model copied the generated model code to the clipboard; {language} is the target language name (for example C# or TypeScript).

credentials_unresolved.location: Object Explorer → Generate Model (single table or view): error text, shown inside the column-read failure status message, when the saved credentials for the node’s connection could not be loaded; {error} is the reason.

generating.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy message while Object Explorer → Generate Model reads one table’s or view’s columns; {language} is the target language, {object} the schema-qualified object name.

generating_scope.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy message while Generate Model builds models for every table in a schema or database; {language} is the target language, {scope} the schema or database name.

list_failed.value: Не удалось получить список таблиц в {scope}: {error}
