cancel_install_button.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: button shown only while the update is downloading or unpacking; stops that job and restores the usual buttons.

check_again_button.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: button that checks the update server again right away for a newer release.

download_label.location: Update Summary dialog → Body: label with a colon placed before the link to the website's download page for every platform.

download_when_idle.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: button label, when this copy cannot self-install, that downloads once current work ends; {work} lists running work, such as “2 queries”.

install_failed_with_download.value: Не удалось установить обновление: {error} Вы можете скачать его по ссылке ниже.
install_failed_with_download.location: Update Summary dialog → Body: red error under the release notes after the in-app install fails; {error} is the reason, followed by a pointer to the download link.

install_when_idle.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: button label, while work is running, that installs once it all finishes; {work} lists running work, such as “1 query, 1 dump”.

installed_version.location: Update Summary dialog → Body: dim line under the heading stating the currently installed version; {version} is that version number.

manual_install_note.value: {reason} Скачайте новую версию и вручную замените текущую установку.
manual_install_note.location: Update Summary dialog → Body: small print shown when this copy cannot update itself; {reason} is a full sentence explaining why, followed by this instruction.

restart_when_idle.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: button label, once the update is ready but work is running, that restarts after it finishes; {work} lists the running work.

skip_button.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: button that skips this version so SQLLY stops announcing it; later versions are still offered.

skipped_note.value: Вы пропустили v{version} — пропуск сбрасывается при загрузке обновления.
skipped_note.location: Update Summary dialog → Body: dim note shown when a version was previously skipped; {version} is that version; downloading clears the skip.

snooze_button.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: button that closes the dialog and postpones the update reminder for a while.

startup_notice_toggle.location: Update Summary dialog → Footer: checkbox at the left; when on, this dialog opens at launch whenever an update is available.

title.location: Update Summary dialog → Title bar: title of the dialog listing what is new since the installed build, with buttons to install, skip or postpone the update.

waiting_for_idle.location: Update Summary dialog → Body: dim note under the version lines shown while an install-when-idle request is pending; points to the cancel button in the footer.

already_current.value: У вас уже установлена последняя версия.
already_current.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when, at download time, the latest published release turns out to be no newer than the running copy; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

browser_current.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason in the browser preview explaining it cannot install updates because the web version is always the latest; shown before the sentence telling the user to download and replace manually.

cancelled.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: message reported when the user pressed Cancel while the in-app update was downloading or unpacking; the dialog returns to its idle buttons.

checksum_mismatch.value: Файл не совпал с опубликованной контрольной суммой и был удален. Попробуйте еще раз или скачайте обновление с sqlly.app.
checksum_mismatch.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the downloaded update's SHA-256 checksum does not match the one published for the release, so the file was deleted; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

checksum_missing.value: У этого релиза нет опубликованной контрольной суммы, поэтому SQLLY не может проверить загрузку. Вместо этого скачайте обновление с sqlly.app.
checksum_missing.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the release on sqlly.app has no recorded checksum, so the in-app installer refuses it and points to the website download; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

command_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: generic install failure when a system helper program (disk mount, copy, signature check, unpack) ran but exited with an error; {operation} is a short verb phrase such as “unpack the update”, {error} is the helper's error output.

command_spawn_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: generic install failure when a system helper program (disk mount, copy, signature check, unpack) could not even be launched; {operation} is a short verb phrase such as “open the disk image”, {error} is the system's launch error.

copy_new_version.location: In-app update → Failed step name (macOS): verb phrase in lowercase that fills {operation} in “Couldn't {operation}: {error}”; must read naturally after “Couldn't”/“No se pudo”; names the step that copies the new SQLLY.app out of the mounted disk image next to the installed app.

disk_image.value: SQLLY запущен из образа диска. Сначала перетащите его в «Программы».
disk_image.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason (macOS) the copy cannot update itself because SQLLY is being run straight from the mounted installer disk image; tells the user to drag it to Applications first.

disk_image_no_app.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (macOS) shown when the downloaded and mounted disk image contains no .app bundle to copy; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

disk_image_read_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (macOS) shown when the contents of the mounted update disk image cannot be listed; {error} is the file-system error text.

download_directory_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the temporary folder for the update download cannot be created; {path} is the folder path, {error} is the file-system error.

download_http_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when sqlly.app answers the update download request with an HTTP error; {status} is the numeric HTTP status code, such as 404.

download_incomplete.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the update download ended with fewer bytes than the server announced; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

download_interrupted.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the network connection dropped partway through downloading the update; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

download_save_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the downloaded update cannot be written or renamed on disk (for example a full disk); {error} is the file-system error.

download_server_unreachable.value: Не удалось подключиться к sqlly.app для загрузки обновления.
download_server_unreachable.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when SQLLY cannot connect to sqlly.app, either to look up the latest release or to fetch the file; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

download_start_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when SQLLY cannot set up the download (network client or temporary folder preparation failed) before any data is transferred; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

install_failed_kept_previous.value: SQLLY не смог установить v{version} и сохранил вашу текущую версию.
install_failed_kept_previous.location: Next launch after an update → Status bar and notification center: message written by the background installer when swapping in v{version} failed and it rolled back to the old copy; shown once when SQLLY relaunches. {version} is the version number without the leading v.

install_location.value: SQLLY не смог определить папку своей установки.
install_location.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason the copy cannot update itself because SQLLY could not determine the folder it is installed in; also used as an install failure reason during unpacking.

install_not_writable.value: У SQLLY нет права записи в {path}, поэтому он не может обновить сам себя.
install_not_writable.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason the copy cannot update itself because the user lacks write permission to its install folder; {path} is that folder.

installer_start_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Restart to update: error shown when the background helper script that installs the update after SQLLY quits cannot be written or launched; {error} is the system error. SQLLY does not quit.

linux_binary_missing.value: В загрузке отсутствует исполняемый файл SQLLY.
linux_binary_missing.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (Linux) shown when the unpacked update tarball does not contain the SQLLY program file; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

mac_requires_mac.value: Сборку для macOS можно установить из приложения только на macOS.
mac_requires_mac.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when a macOS update package is being installed on a non-macOS system (should not normally happen); also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

no_build.value: Для этого компьютера сборка ещё не опубликована.
no_build.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when sqlly.app has no release published for this operating system and processor yet; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

not_app_bundle.value: Этот SQLLY не запущен из пакета приложения.
not_app_bundle.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason (macOS) the copy cannot update itself because the running program is not inside a SQLLY.app bundle (for example a developer build).

not_newer.value: Загруженная версия — v{version}, она не новее установленной.
not_newer.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (macOS) shown when the version inside the downloaded app is not newer than the running one; {version} is that downloaded version number without the leading v.

not_packaged_binary.value: Этот SQLLY — не тот исполняемый файл, который входит в пакет.
not_packaged_binary.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason (Linux) the copy cannot update itself because the running program file is not the packaged one named SQLLY (for example a renamed or developer build).

open_disk_image.location: In-app update → Failed step name (macOS): verb phrase in lowercase that fills {operation} in “Couldn't {operation}: {error}”; must read naturally after “Couldn't”/“No se pudo”; names the step that mounts the downloaded update disk image.

read_new_version.location: In-app update → Failed step name (macOS): verb phrase in lowercase that fills {operation} in “Couldn't {operation}: {error}”; must read naturally after “Couldn't”/“No se pudo”; names the step that reads the version number out of the downloaded app before installing it.

stage_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (Linux) shown when the staging folder next to the installed program cannot be created for unpacking the update; {error} is the file-system error.

stopped_unexpectedly.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the background download job ended without any result (it crashed); also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

store_managed.value: Эта версия обновляется через магазин приложений.
store_managed.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason in App Store or Microsoft Store editions explaining that in-app updates are disabled because the store delivers updates.

translocated.value: macOS запускает SQLLY из временной копии. Переместите SQLLY.app в «Программы», откройте его оттуда и попробуйте снова.
translocated.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason (macOS) the copy cannot update itself because macOS is running it from a temporary, randomized location (App Translocation); tells the user to move SQLLY.app to Applications and reopen it.

unexpected_download.value: Сервер предложил неожиданный файл для загрузки ({name}).
unexpected_download.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the release file name offered by the server is not a valid SQLLY package for this system, so it is refused; {name} is the offered file name.

unpack_stopped.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when the background job extracting the downloaded update crashed before finishing; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

unpack_update.location: In-app update → Failed step name (Windows and Linux): verb phrase in lowercase that fills {operation} in “Couldn't {operation}: {error}”; must read naturally after “Couldn't”/“No se pudo”; names the step that extracts the downloaded zip or tarball.

unsupported_os.location: Update Summary dialog → Manual-install small print: reason the copy cannot update itself because in-app installs are not supported on this operating system; {os} is the system's internal name, such as freebsd.

update_read_failed.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (Windows) shown when the unpacked update folder cannot be listed; {error} is the file-system error.

verify_signature.location: In-app update → Failed step name (macOS): verb phrase in lowercase that fills {operation} in “Couldn't {operation}: {error}”; must read naturally after “Couldn't”/“No se pudo”; names the step that checks the code signature of the downloaded app.

windows_binary_missing.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (Windows) shown when the unpacked update zip does not contain SQLLY.exe; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

windows_requires_windows.value: Сборку для Windows можно установить из приложения только на Windows.
windows_requires_windows.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason shown when a Windows update package is being installed on a non-Windows system (should not normally happen); also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

wrong_developer.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (macOS) shown when the downloaded app is signed by a different Apple developer team than the installed one, so it is refused as untrusted; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

wrong_publisher.location: Update Summary dialog → Install error: install failure reason (Windows) shown when the downloaded SQLLY.exe is not validly signed by the same publisher as the installed one, so it is refused; also follows “Update failed:” in the status bar.

available.location: Status bar → Notification center (bell): entry added when a check finds a new release; {version} is the new version number. Same wording as the update dialog title but recorded as a history item.

idle_download.location: Status bar → Notification center (bell): entry added when SQLLY becomes idle after the user chose “Download when idle” and it now opens the browser download page; {version} is the new version.

standalone_build.value: Проверка обновлений отключена в этой автономной сборке: она никогда не связывается с sqlly.app. Чтобы обновиться, пересоберите SQLLY из исходников.
standalone_build.location: Help → Check for Updates: warning in the status bar and a toast when the user checks for updates. Shown only in standalone builds (compiled with the standalone option), which never contact sqlly.app.

cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar: informational message shown after the user presses Cancel in the Update Summary dialog to stop an in-progress update download.

check_failed.value: Проверка обновлений не удалась — попробуйте позже
check_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: warning shown after a manual Help → Check for Updates could not reach the update server; a matching toast pops up at the same time.

checking.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy message shown while a manual Help → Check for Updates request is in progress.

download_when_idle.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after choosing “Download when idle” in the Update Summary dialog while work is running; {work} is a comma-separated list of running work such as “2 queries, 1 dump”.

failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the in-app download or install of an update fails; {error} is the specific reason sentence.

installer_launch_failed.location: SQLLY update dialog → Restart and Install action: error status shown when the staged installer helper cannot be launched; {error} is the localized launch failure.

ready_to_restart.value: SQLLY v{version} готов — перезапустите для обновления
ready_to_restart.location: Workbench → Status bar and notification center: success message shown when the update has been downloaded and staged, waiting for a restart; {version} is the new version.

restart_when_idle.value: Перезапуск для обновления произойдёт при простое ({work})
restart_when_idle.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after choosing “Restart when idle” in the Update Summary dialog while work is running; SQLLY will restart into the update once {work} (a list such as “2 queries, 1 dump”) finishes.

skipped.value: Версия v{version} пропущена; о следующем релизе сообщим.
skipped.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after pressing “Skip this version” in the Update Summary dialog; {version} is the skipped version.

snoozed.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after pressing “Remind me later” in the Update Summary dialog; the update notice is hidden for a day.

store_managed.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown on Help → Check for Updates in store editions; {version} is the installed version, {store} is the store name such as “App Store” or “Microsoft Store”.

up_to_date.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message after a manual Help → Check for Updates finds no newer release; {version} is the installed version. Short; a fuller toast appears too.

check_failed.value: Проверка обновлений не удалась — попробуйте позже
check_failed.location: Help → Check for Updates → Toast notification: warning pop-up shown when a manual update check could not reach the server; mirrors the status-bar message.

up_to_date.value: У вас последняя версия — SQLLY v{version}.
up_to_date.location: Help → Check for Updates → Toast notification: success pop-up shown when a manual check finds no newer release; {version} is the installed version.

ai_run_plural.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: plural count of AI assistant runs still in progress; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is 2 or more.

ai_run_singular.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: singular count of AI assistant runs still in progress; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is always 1.

dump_plural.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: plural count of database dump jobs still running; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is 2 or more.

dump_singular.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: singular count of database dump jobs still running; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is always 1.

query_plural.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: plural count of queries still executing; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is 2 or more.

query_singular.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: singular count of queries still executing; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is always 1.

task_plural.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: plural count of export or other background tasks still running; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is 2 or more.

task_singular.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: singular count of export or other background tasks still running; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is always 1.

transaction_plural.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: plural count of manual transactions left open (not yet committed or rolled back); one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is 2 or more.

transaction_singular.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: singular count of manual transactions left open (not yet committed or rolled back); one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is always 1.

transfer_plural.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: plural count of data transfer jobs still running; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is 2 or more.

transfer_singular.location: Update Summary dialog and status bar → Running-work list: singular count of data transfer jobs still running; one item in the comma-separated list filling {work} in “Install/Restart/Download when idle ({work})”; {count} is always 1.

new_connection.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas: accent-filled button that opens the new connection editor; desktop app only, shown when no query tab is open.

browser_demo.value: Это демонстрация во вкладке. Запросы выполняются в демонстрационной базе данных, а не на ваших серверах.
browser_demo.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas: invitation line under the SQLLY headline in the browser preview, explaining that queries run against an in-tab sample database, not real servers.

choose_connection.value: Выберите подключение, чтобы начать выполнять запросы.
choose_connection.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas: invitation line under the SQLLY headline shown when the user has saved connections, listed below it to click.

proxied_connections.value: Ваш администратор настроил эти подключения. Выберите одно, чтобы начать выполнять запросы.
proxied_connections.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas: invitation line under the SQLLY headline when connections are provided by an administrator through a relay or SQLly Embedded bridge.

zero_connections.value: Добавьте своё первое подключение, чтобы начать выполнять запросы.
zero_connections.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas: invitation line under the SQLLY headline shown on first run when no connections are saved yet, above the New Connection button.

command_palette.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas → shortcuts table: row label for opening the command palette.

run_query.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas → Shortcuts table: row label next to the keycap for running the current query; short command name.

toggle_sidebar.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas → Shortcuts table: row label next to the keycap that shows or hides the connections sidebar; short command name.

ai_assistant.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas → Feature tiles: title of the tile showcasing the built-in AI assistant, shown when no connections exist (replaced by “MCP” in editions that can launch programs).

charts.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas → Feature tiles: title of the tile showcasing result charting, shown when no connections are saved yet; one or two words.

notebooks.location: Workbench → Welcome canvas → Feature tiles: title of the tile showcasing SQL notebooks, shown when no connections are saved yet; one or two words.

active_badge.location: Workspaces → Manage → Saved workspace row: badge identifying the currently active workspace.

confirm_delete_button.location: Workspaces → Manage: second-step button that permanently deletes the selected saved workspace.

delete_button.location: Workspaces → Manage: first-step button that asks for confirmation before deleting the selected workspace.

duplicate_button.location: Workspaces → Manage: button that creates a copy of the selected workspace.

duplicate_name.location: Workspaces → Manage → Duplicate: default name assigned to the copied workspace.

manage_description.value: Открыть, переименовать, дублировать или удалить сохранённое рабочее пространство. Привязанные подключения запоминаются, но не подключаются автоматически.
manage_description.location: Workspaces → Manage: explanatory paragraph describing available actions and the disconnected restore policy.

manage_title.location: Workspaces → Manage: dialog title for opening and maintaining saved workspaces.

name_placeholder.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: placeholder in the text field for the new workspace name.

name_required.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: inline validation error shown when saving with an empty name.

open_button.location: Workspaces → Manage: primary button that restores the selected workspace.

rename_button.location: Workspaces → Manage: button that applies the edited name to the selected workspace.

save_button.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: primary button that saves the entered workspace name and current state.

save_description.value: Сохраняет открытые SQL-файлы, несохранённые вкладки, привязанные подключения, корень проекта и текущую раскладку панелей. После открытия рабочее пространство остаётся без подключений, пока вы не нажмёте «Подключить» или не выполните запрос.
save_description.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: explanatory paragraph describing captured state and the disconnected restore policy.

save_title.location: Workspaces → Save Workspace As: dialog title for saving the current tabs and layout under a new name.

saved_count.location: SQLLY → Workspaces dialog: footer showing how many named workspaces are saved and the maximum allowed.

selection_placeholder.location: Workspaces → Manage: placeholder in the name field before a saved workspace is selected.

deleted.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after deleting a saved workspace in the Workspaces dialog (past participle).

duplicated.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after duplicating a saved workspace in the Workspaces dialog (past participle).

renamed.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after renaming a saved workspace in the Workspaces dialog (past participle).

restored.value: Рабочее пространство восстановлено — без подключений, пока вы не нажмёте «Подключить»
restored.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after a saved workspace's tabs and layout are reopened (past participle).

saved.location: Workbench → Status bar: one-word success message after saving the current state under a new name in Save Workspace As (past participle).

capacity.value: Можно сохранить не более {maximum} именованных рабочих пространств.
capacity.location: Workspaces → Save error: message shown when saving another workspace would exceed the named-workspace limit.

invalid_id.location: Workspaces → Storage error: message shown when a saved workspace identifier is not a valid UUID.

name_empty.value: Название рабочего пространства не может быть пустым.
name_empty.location: Workspaces → Name validation: storage error shown when the trimmed workspace name is empty.

name_too_long.value: Название рабочего пространства — не более {maximum} символов.
name_too_long.location: Workspaces → Name validation: storage error shown when the workspace name exceeds the character limit.

not_found.location: Workspaces → Storage error: message shown when the requested saved workspace no longer exists.

snapshot_corrupt.value: Снимок этого рабочего пространства отсутствует или повреждён.
snapshot_corrupt.location: Workspaces → Storage error: message shown when a saved workspace snapshot cannot be loaded or decoded.

intro.value: Сохранённые подключения, сниппеты, запросы из SQL-библиотеки и синхронизируемые настройки будут одинаковыми на каждом Mac, где выполнен вход в вашу учётную запись Apple. Синхронизация использует папку в вашем собственном iCloud Drive и выключена, пока вы её не включите.
intro.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: introductory paragraph at the top of the pane explaining what iCloud sync does and that it is off until turned on.

enable_label.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: label of the checkbox that turns iCloud sync on or off for this Mac (off by default).

section_syncs.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the list of what iCloud sync copies between Macs.

syncs_connections.value: Сохранённые подключения с их заметками, клиентами, проектами, средами, цветами, значками и профилями туннелей.
syncs_connections.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line saying saved connections and their labels, colors, icons and tunnel profiles sync.

syncs_snippets.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line saying snippets and quick actions sync.

syncs_library.value: Запросы в SQL-библиотеке, пока она находится в папке по умолчанию (файлы до 1 МБ).
syncs_library.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line saying SQL Library query files sync when the library is in its default folder, up to 1 MB each.

syncs_settings.value: Внешний вид, редактор, горячие клавиши, форматирование SQL, форматирование результатов, условное форматирование, конфиденциальные столбцы, обозреватель серверов, настройки вкладок и транзакций.
syncs_settings.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What syncs: line listing which settings sync between Macs.

section_never.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the list of what iCloud sync never copies.

never_secrets.value: Пароли, парольные фразы SSH-ключей, токены и ключи API остаются в связке ключей этого Mac. Подключение с другого Mac запросит пароль при первом использовании.
never_secrets.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What never syncs: line saying passwords, SSH passphrases, tokens and API keys stay in this Mac's keychain, and a synced connection asks for its password on first connect on another Mac.

never_local.value: Общие учётные записи, история запросов, открытые вкладки, настройки ИИ и MCP, а также настройки, указывающие на программы или файлы на этом Mac.
never_local.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → What never syncs: line listing other things that stay on this Mac (shared logins, history, tabs, AI and tool settings).

section_conflicts.value: Когда два Mac расходятся во мнениях
section_conflicts.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the explanation of how iCloud sync resolves conflicting changes.

conflicts_hint.value: Каждый элемент сохраняет самое свежее изменение, а если удалить элемент, он удалится на всех Mac. Если отредактированный здесь запрос уступает более новой версии, ваша версия сохранится рядом как конфликтная копия.
conflicts_hint.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → When two Macs disagree: explanation that the most recent change to an item wins, deletes apply everywhere, and an edited query that loses is kept as a conflicted copy.

section_status.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: section heading above the current sync status and the Sync Now button.

sync_now.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: button that runs a sync right away instead of waiting for the next automatic one.

off_hint.value: При выключении синхронизация останавливается. Ничего не удаляется ни с этого Mac, ни из iCloud.
off_hint.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: note under the checkbox explaining that turning sync off removes nothing from this Mac or iCloud.

restart_hint.value: Подключения, сниппеты и запросы с ваших других Mac появляются сразу; настройки вступают в силу при следующем запуске SQLLY.
restart_hint.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: note explaining that connections, snippets and queries from another Mac appear right away while settings take effect at the next launch.

app_store_unavailable.value: Синхронизация iCloud недоступна в версии для Mac App Store. Чтобы скопировать подключения на другой Mac, используйте Файл ▸ Экспорт подключений на этом Mac и Файл ▸ Импорт подключений на другом Mac.
app_store_unavailable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: notice shown instead of an active checkbox in the Mac App Store edition, which cannot use iCloud sync.

unsupported.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: notice shown in place of the pane's controls on systems other than macOS.

save_failed.value: Не удалось сохранить настройку синхронизации iCloud: {error}
save_failed.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync: error shown under the checkbox when the on/off choice could not be saved; {error} is the system's error text.

off.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line while sync is turned off.

waiting.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line right after sync is turned on, before the first sync finishes.

not_signed_in.value: Этот Mac не вошёл в iCloud. Войдите в Системные настройки ▸ Учётная запись Apple, затем включите iCloud Drive.
not_signed_in.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when this Mac is not signed in to iCloud.

drive_off.value: iCloud Drive отключён на этом Mac. Включите его в Системных настройках ▸ Учётная запись Apple ▸ iCloud ▸ iCloud Drive.
drive_off.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when the Mac is signed in to iCloud but iCloud Drive is turned off.

unavailable.value: Синхронизация iCloud недоступна в этой версии SQLLY.
unavailable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when this edition or system cannot use iCloud sync.

state_unreadable.value: Синхронизация остановлена, так как её запись на этом Mac ({path}) не читается: {detail}. Ничего не изменилось.
state_unreadable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when this Mac's own sync record file cannot be read; {path} is the file, {detail} the error. Nothing was changed.

folder_unreadable.value: Синхронизация остановлена, так как папка iCloud {path} не читается: {detail}. Ничего не изменилось.
folder_unreadable.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when the iCloud Drive sync folder cannot be listed; {path} is the folder, {detail} the error. Nothing was changed.

write_failed.value: Синхронизация не смогла записать в {path}: {detail}. Попытка повторится при следующей синхронизации.
write_failed.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: problem shown when SQLLY could not write its sync file or record; {path} is where, {detail} the error. It retries on the next sync.

synced.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line after a successful sync that brought nothing new; {time} is the local time of day.

synced_with_changes.value: Последняя синхронизация: {time}. Изменения с других ваших Mac: {count}.
synced_with_changes.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: status line after a successful sync that applied changes from other Macs; {time} is the local time of day, {count} the number of changes.

skipped_damaged.value: Файл {file_name} в iCloud пропущен: он повреждён или не является файлом синхронизации SQLLY. Из-за него на этом Mac ничего не изменилось.
skipped_damaged.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note under the status naming a file in the iCloud sync folder that was ignored because it is damaged or not a sync file; {file_name} is its name.

skipped_newer.value: Файл {file_name} в iCloud пропущен: его создала более новая версия SQLLY. Обновите SQLLY на этом Mac, чтобы синхронизироваться с тем Mac.
skipped_newer.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note naming a sync file in iCloud written by a newer version of SQLLY, which this Mac skips until updated; {file_name} is its name.

downloading.value: Файлы синхронизации всё ещё загружаются из iCloud: {count}. Они будут прочитаны при следующей синхронизации.
downloading.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note saying how many sync files iCloud is still downloading to this Mac; {count} is that number.

not_applied.value: Элементы из iCloud ещё не применены на этом Mac: {count}. SQLLY попробует снова при следующей синхронизации.
not_applied.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note saying how many incoming items could not be applied on this Mac yet; {count} is that number. They are retried.

conflicted_copy.value: Изменённый вами запрос сохранён как {file_name}, так как с другого Mac пришла более новая версия.
conflicted_copy.location: Settings → Workspace → iCloud Sync → Status: note naming a SQL Library file where this Mac's edited version was kept as a conflicted copy; {file_name} is the copy's path inside the library.

updated.value: Синхронизация iCloud принесла изменения с ваших других Mac.
updated.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown after iCloud sync brought in changes to connections, snippets or queries from another Mac.
